title: E-commerce Virtual Assistant (Shopify & Customer Service)
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a reliable, proactive, and detail-oriented E-commerce Virtual Assistant to join our growing online business.



You will be responsible for managing day-to-day customer service and e-commerce operations, including handling customer enquiries, processing orders, coordinating with suppliers, managing refunds and replacements, and maintaining accurate order and inventory records.



The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities, communicates proactively, learns quickly, and can work independently with minimal supervision.



We value reliability, trustworthiness, and a strong work ethic just as much as technical skills. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the business over the long term.





Key Responsibilities



1. Customer Service



- Respond to customer enquiries via
, social media comments, and direct messages in a professional, friendly, and timely manner.



- Handle questions regarding orders, shipping, tracking, product information, returns, and refunds.



- Resolve customer issues efficiently while maintaining a positive customer experience.



- Escalate complex or sensitive cases when necessary.





2. Shopify & Order Management



- Manage daily order processing and monitor order statuses through Shopify.



- Track shipments and investigate delayed, missing, or problematic orders.



- Process refunds, cancellations, and other order adjustments according to company procedures.



- Maintain accurate customer and order records.



- Identify and flag order discrepancies or potential fulfilment issues.





3. Supplier & Fulfilment Coordination



- Liaise with suppliers regarding order issues, replacements, missing items, and fulfilment delays.



- Follow up proactively with suppliers to ensure outstanding issues are resolved.



- Monitor inventory levels and communicate potential stock shortages.



- Develop a basic understanding of e-commerce fulfilment, shipping processes, and order tracking.





4. Administrative & Reporting Tasks



- Use Google Sheets, Google Docs, Microsoft Excel, and other productivity tools to maintain records and track operational data.



- Keep customer service logs, refund records, and order-related spreadsheets organized and up to date.



- Follow established standard operating procedures (SOPs) and help identify opportunities to improve workflows.



- Provide regular updates on completed tasks, pending issues, and operational concerns.





Requirements



- Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience in e-commerce, virtual assistance, customer service, or online store operations.



- Shopify experience is a must. You should be comfortable navigating the Shopify admin and managing orders, refunds, and customer information.



- Strong written English communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally.



- Proficiency in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets and Google Docs, and Microsoft Excel.



- Basic understanding of e-commerce fulfilment, shipping, tracking, and returns processes.



- Good problem-solving skills and the ability to handle routine tasks independently.



- Exceptional time management, organizational skills, and attention to detail.



- A reliable computer or laptop and a stable, high-speed internet connection with a dependable ISP.



- Ability to work full-time during agreed working hours and remain responsive throughout the workday.





Personal Qualities We Value



The right candidate should be:



- Reliable and trustworthy: You can be counted on to complete tasks accurately and consistently.



- Proactive: You identify problems, follow up on outstanding issues, and take action without waiting to be reminded.



- Responsive: You communicate promptly and keep the team informed of important developments.



- Organized: You can manage multiple tasks, prioritize deadlines, and maintain accurate records.



- Willing to learn: You are open to feedback, comfortable learning new tools, and committed to improving your skills.



- Accountable: You take ownership of your work, communicate mistakes honestly, and focus on finding solutions.



- Detail-oriented: You understand that small errors in orders, refunds, or customer communications can affect the business.





Compensation & Benefits



- Monthly salary of USD $600–$800, depending on experience and capabilities.



- Annual performance-based bonus.



- Full-time, remote position.



- Opportunity to develop your e-commerce operations and customer service skills within a growing online business.



- Potential for long-term career growth based on performance, reliability, and contribution to the business.





How to Apply

title: Real Estate Phone Expert
description:
About the role:

We're a townhome development company actively acquiring land in Arizona, and we're looking for a full-time acquisitions specialist who is genuinely great on the phone — someone who builds instant rapport, earns trust fast, and knows how to close deals. This is a full-time, long-term remote role with room to grow as we scale into new markets.



You'll be the voice of our company on the phone — reaching out to property owners, connecting with real estate agents and brokers, building relationships, handling objections, and guiding sellers all the way to a signed agreement.



This role is for a skilled closer who thrives on rapport and loves getting deals done.



What you'll do:



Outbound calls to property owners, agents, and brokers

Build genuine rapport and earn trust fast

Qualify sellers (motivation, timeline, property details)

Handle objections and drive conversations toward a deal

Present offers, negotiate, and close signed agreements

Handle inbound calls and same-day callbacks

Persistent follow-up via call, text, and

Keep notes organized in our CRM



What makes you a fit — you're an acquisitions specialist who:



Builds rapport instantly — people trust you and open up within the first minute

Closes — you move a hesitant seller from "maybe" to "yes" and get it signed

Is confident on the phone — you enjoy the work and don't get rattled by rejection

Handles objections smoothly and keeps deals moving

Knows the acquisitions game — real estate, land, or development acquisitions experience strongly preferred (wholesaling, land acquisition, investor call teams, US real estate calling)



What we're looking for:



Excellent, clear spoken English with a warm, confident, trustworthy phone presence

Experience calling US property owners and agents strongly preferred

A natural relationship builder and closer — this is your core strength

Proven acquisitions / sales results — you can point to deals you've closed

Self-motivated, resilient, and persistent — never lets a lead go cold

Reliable, dedicated, and looking for a long-term home

Comfortable with CRM tools, texting, and

Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, professional calling environment



Hours & Schedule:



Monday–Friday

9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST

Long-term, ongoing role for the right person



Please submit a short 1–2 minute video introducing yourself, highlighting your sales or acquisitions experience, and explaining why you would be a great fit for this position.



We're building something for the long term and want a dedicated acquisitions specialist who's a natural at rapport and closing, wants a stable full-time role, and takes pride in getting deals done. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Video Editor / Graphics Designer - Australian Timezone
description:
Project-Based / Part-Time | Remote | Australian Business Hours



We are looking for a creative, reliable, and highly skilled Video Editor & Graphic Designer to join our growing marketing team.



The ideal candidate has experience working with Australian clients, particularly in the gym, fitness, and health & wellness industry, and can produce professional, engaging, high-quality content across multiple digital platforms.



This role is ideal for someone who can work independently, manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and communicate proactively.



Key Responsibilities

-Video Editing

-Repurpose long-form videos into engaging short-form content, including Instagram Reels, TikTok videos,

-Add engaging captions, transitions, motion graphics, B-roll, sound effects, and music.

-Create attention-grabbing hooks and maintain strong storytelling throughout videos.

-Ensure videos are optimised for different social media platforms.

-Maintain consistent branding and professional video quality.



Graphic Design

-Design professional social media graphics, carousels, thumbnails, and promotional materials.

-Create branded podcast covers, YouTube thumbnails, and marketing assets.

-Design graphics for digital advertising campaigns,
 marketing, and websites.

-Follow existing brand guidelines while bringing fresh creative ideas.



Requirements

-Proven experience working with Australian clients is essential.

-Previous experience creating content for gyms, fitness businesses, or the health and wellness industry is highly preferred.

-Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar video editing software.

-Proficiency in Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar graphic design tools.

-Experience editing both long-form podcasts and short-form social media videos.

-Strong understanding of social media trends, video hooks, pacing, and audience engagement.

-Must be available during Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT).

-Must be highly responsive, reliable, and proactive in communication.

-Potential for ongoing work based on performance

-Your updated CV or professional profile.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) – Inbound Sales, Cold Calling & Operations
description:
Sales Development Representative (SDR) – Inbound Sales, Cold Calling & Operations



Company: ClearCoast Cleaning LLC



Location: Remote



Employment Type: Full-Time



Schedule: 40 hours per week, aligned with U.S. Pacific Time business hours



Base Pay: $5.50–$7.50 per hour, depending on experience



Additional Compensation: Uncapped sales commissions and performance-based bonuses



About ClearCoast Cleaning



ClearCoast Cleaning is a growing residential and commercial cleaning company serving the Seattle, Washington area. We provide recurring residential cleaning, deep cleaning, move-out cleaning, apartment turnover services, and commercial cleaning.



Our business is built around reliable service, consistent quality, and clear communication. We are focused on growing our customer base, building long-term relationships with property managers, and expanding our commercial cleaning accounts.



We are looking for a motivated, proactive, and results-driven Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help generate new business, convert incoming leads into paying customers, and support daily operations.



About the Role



This position combines sales development, inbound lead conversion, outbound prospecting, customer relationship management, and morning operations coordination.



Approximately 70% of your time will focus on sales and business development, while 30% will involve morning operations and service coordination.



You will be responsible for contacting prospective customers, making cold calls, following up on quotes, handling objections, booking cleaning services, and developing new business opportunities with property managers and commercial clients.



You will also help ensure that daily cleaning operations start smoothly by coordinating schedules, communicating with cleaners, and resolving routine service issues.



This is not a passive administrative position. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, communicates confidently, follows through consistently, and is motivated by achieving measurable results.



Key Responsibilities



1. Inbound Sales and Lead Conversion



Respond promptly to incoming calls,
s, text messages, and online cleaning inquiries.



Contact new leads quickly and guide them through the booking process.



Understand customer needs and recommend appropriate cleaning services.



Explain service options, present pricing, and communicate our value professionally.



Follow up with prospects who have received quotes but have not booked.



Handle objections related to price, scheduling, trust, and service expectations.



Confidently ask for the sale and convert qualified leads into booked appointments.



Follow up with previous customers and unconverted leads to generate repeat business.



Maintain accurate records of inquiries, quotes, follow-ups, and booking outcomes.



2. Outbound Sales and Cold Calling



Make outbound calls to property managers, apartment communities, real estate companies, landlords, offices, schools, and other commercial prospects.



Identify decision-makers and introduce ClearCoast Cleaning's services.



Generate opportunities for apartment turnovers, move-out cleaning, recurring residential cleaning, and commercial cleaning contracts.



Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified prospects.



Follow up consistently with prospects through phone calls and
s.



Schedule walkthroughs, estimates, discovery calls, and meetings with potential commercial clients.



Develop relationships with property managers and other decision-makers.



Research potential customers and identify new business opportunities.



Work toward agreed-upon calling, appointment-setting, conversion, and revenue targets.



3. Sales Pipeline and CRM Management



Maintain accurate lead records, contact details, call notes, quotes, and follow-up dates.



Track prospects through each stage of the sales pipeline.



Ensure qualified leads receive timely follow-ups.



Use our CRM, booking platform, spreadsheets, and communication tools to manage sales activity.



Track outreach activity, appointments generated, conversion rates, and qualifying revenue.



Provide regular updates on sales performance and pipeline progress.



Help improve sales scripts, follow-up sequences, objection handling, and lead-conversion processes.



Maintain organized records so opportunities are not lost due to missed follow-ups.



4. Morning Operations and Service Coordination



Review the daily cleaning schedule and ensure jobs are properly organized.



Confirm cleaner availability, assignments, arrival windows, and special instructions.



Ensure cleaners have the necessary property access information and job notes before arrival.



Monitor morning arrivals and follow up promptly if a cleaner is late or unresponsive.



Coordinate schedule changes, replacement cleaners, and urgent service issues.



Communicate with cleaners and customers to prevent missed appointments and scheduling problems.



Escalate property access issues, customer complaints, and other significant problems to management.



Ensure required job photos, checklists, and completion updates are submitted.



Help coordinate corrective cleanings and customer follow-ups when necessary.



Maintain accurate operational records and provide updates to management.



5. Customer Relationships and Business Growth



Follow up with existing customers to encourage repeat bookings and recurring cleaning plans.



Identify appropriate opportunities for additional services and recurring packages.



Support customer reactivation campaigns and approved outreach initiatives.



Help build long-term relationships with residential customers, property managers, and commercial accounts.



Coordinate with the operations team to ensure customer expectations are communicated accurately.



Identify recurring problems and recommend ways to improve customer experience and business processes.



Compensation: Base Pay, Commission, and Bonuses



We want to reward people who contribute to measurable business growth.



Base Pay:



$5.50–$7.50 per hour, depending on relevant experience, communication skills, and qualifications.



Sales Commissions:



Earn additional commission on eligible new sales that you generate and help close.



Commission opportunities may include new residential customers, recurring cleaning accounts, and qualifying commercial contracts.



Larger commercial accounts may qualify for a separate commission structure.



Commission rates, eligibility requirements, revenue attribution, and payment schedules will be provided in writing before employment begins.



Performance Bonuses:



Additional bonuses for achieving agreed monthly sales and revenue targets.



Potential bonuses for acquiring new recurring customers, generating qualified commercial opportunities, and meeting agreed performance milestones.



Additional earning opportunities for consistent performance and increased responsibility.



There is no arbitrary cap on commission earnings under the applicable commission plan. Actual earnings depend on qualifying sales and performance.



Routine operations and administrative responsibilities are covered by the base compensation. Sales commissions and bonuses are tied to eligible results under the written compensation plan.



Qualifications



Required Qualifications:



Strong spoken and written English.



A confident and professional phone presence.



Previous experience in sales, cold calling, lead generation, appointment setting, customer service, or business development.



Comfort making outbound calls and speaking with unfamiliar prospects.



Ability to handle objections and follow up without becoming discouraged by rejection.



Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.



Ability to manage multiple leads and operational priorities.



Professional communication with U.S. customers and business decision-makers.



Reliable internet connection, computer, headset, and quiet working environment.



Ability to work independently, follow processes, and meet agreed performance targets.



Strong accountability, honesty, reliability, and willingness to learn.



Availability to work 40 hours per week aligned with Pacific Time business hours.



Preferred Qualifications:



Experience working with U.S.-based businesses.



Experience selling cleaning services, home services, or recurring services.



Experience cold-calling property managers, apartment communities, or commercial businesses.



Experience converting inbound inquiries into paying customers.



Experience managing a CRM or sales pipeline.



Experience with scheduling platforms, Google Workspace, and spreadsheets.



Experience coordinating remote teams, field service providers, or customer appointments.



A track record of meeting sales quotas, generating appointments, or closing deals.



What Success Looks Like



During the first 30–90 days, performance will be evaluated against agreed-upon targets, including:



Speed and quality of response to inbound leads.



Consistency of outbound calling and prospecting.



Number and quality of qualified appointments generated.



Follow-up completion and quote-to-booking conversion.



New customers, recurring accounts, and qualifying revenue generated.



Accuracy of CRM records and sales reporting.



Reliability of morning scheduling and cleaner coordination.



Timely communication and escalation of operational issues.



Ability to learn, accept coaching, and improve performance over time.



Specific activity goals, sales targets, and operational expectations will be established during onboarding based on lead volume and business needs.



Growth Opportunities



ClearCoast Cleaning is growing, and we want team members who are interested in growing with the business.



High performers may have opportunities to advance into senior sales, business development, sales management, or broader operations leadership positions.



We value initiative, accountability, strong communication, problem-solving, and the ability to consistently deliver results.



The Ideal Candidate



You are proactive, organized, and comfortable taking ownership of your responsibilities.



You do not wait for someone to remind you to follow up with a prospect. You manage your pipeline, make the calls, ask for the sale, and keep working toward a clear outcome.



You are comfortable with rejection, but you know how to communicate value, ask thoughtful questions, handle objections, and move sales conversations forward.



You also understand that operations matter. You can manage schedules, communicate with cleaners, identify problems early, and keep management informed.



Above all, you are dependable, coachable, honest, and motivated to help build a successful business.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



A brief introduction and summary of your relevant experience.



Your experience with cold calling, inbound sales, lead generation, follow-ups, and closing deals.



Any measurable sales achievements, such as revenue generated, conversion rates, appointments booked, or targets achieved.



Your experience with scheduling, customer communication, and operations coordination.



Your expected hourly rate within the advertised range.



Your availability to work 40 hours per week aligned with Pacific Time business hours.



A short voice recording or video introduction explaining why you are a strong fit for this position.



Applications that demonstrate strong communication, initiative, sales ability, and accountability will receive priority consideration.



If you are motivated by sales, enjoy building relationships, take ownership of your work, and want to earn additional compensation based on performance, we encourage you to apply.

title: Video Editor (Premiere Pro) – Full-Time, Long-Term, Remote
description:
Video Editor (Premiere Pro) – Full-Time, Long-Term, Remote



We run faceless documentary channels on YouTube. One is in English and one is in Arabic, and we upload every day. We’re hiring a full-time editor with a great eye.



What the job actually is

You won’t edit from scratch. Every day you get a Premiere Pro project that’s already about 80% built: the voiceover, visuals, archival footage, graphics, text, subtitles, sound effects and music are all placed and timed.



Your job is the last 20%, and it’s the part that matters most: polish it until it feels like a human with taste made it.



Tighten the pacing and fix any cut that feels off

Catch visuals that don’t match what the narrator is saying, and swap them

Make sure nothing feels repetitive, templated or like a slideshow

Sometimes find and add real footage when a scene needs it

You’re the last pair of eyes before upload, so if something looks wrong, you flag it



Taste matters most here. We can teach you our system. We can’t teach someone to feel when a cut is wrong.



What to expect



One finished video per day, every day

Full training from our current editor. You’ll learn the system step by step

Files are shared through Dropbox, and you leave your notes as markers in Premiere

You’ll keep your own notes on everything you learn. Corrections are given once, and you write them down the same day

Calm, story-driven content. No flashy TikTok-style editing



This is long-term, not a gig

We’re growing to 4 channels, all uploading daily. Every new channel will need an editor.



You need



A good eye for pacing, storytelling and detail

A reliable PC and internet connection, plus a Dropbox account

Good English

Honesty: you tell us when something is wrong and never hide it



Nice to have: experience with documentary or YouTube storytelling channels, and skill at finding footage.



**Pay:** $300/month



To apply: send your portfolio (documentary or YouTube work preferred) and one line on why taste matters in editing. Shortlisted applicants get a short paid test edit.

[where to send it]



If you want short-term or easy, this isn’t for you. If you want to build something and grow with it, we’d love to hear from you.

PROSPECTING RESPONSIBILITIES

title: Digital Operations, Marketing & Patient Engagement Specialist
description:
Are you our next amazing team member?

We are seeking a highly motivated, clever, innovative and digitally savvy Digital Growth & Patient Experience Specialist to join our team and help drive the next stage of our business growth.



We are a purpose and values-driven business, founded on the belief that everyone deserves access to safe, effective, evidence-based skin and aesthetic care.



Our approach combines medical expertise, advanced laser technology, dermal therapies and personalised patient care to deliver meaningful, long-term skin health outcomes.



We are looking for an exceptional team member who shares our values, thrives on innovation and continuous improvement, and is passionate about creating outstanding patient experiences while contributing to the growth of our business.



This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining technology, digital marketing, creativity, systems management and patient engagement into one dynamic role.



About the opportunity



As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to work closely with the business owner and manager, contribute to the growth of an ambitious healthcare business, develop your skills and take ownership of projects that make a measurable difference.



We are looking for someone who can see opportunities, develop solutions, improve systems and take initiative — not simply wait to be given tasks.



You don't necessarily need previous experience in the skin or aesthetic medicine industry. However, you will need to be digitally capable, resourceful, an excellent communicator and genuinely enthusiastic about learning new platforms and technologies.



Training in our clinic-specific systems and processes will be provided.



The successful applicant will:



• Be aligned with our business purpose, culture and values.

• Be highly motivated, proactive, innovative and solutions-focused.

• Thrive working autonomously and take ownership of responsibilities.

• Be results-driven and focused on measurable outcomes.

• Demonstrate initiative and continually identify opportunities for improvement.

• Be comfortable learning, implementing and troubleshooting digital systems.

• Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

• Have exceptional attention to detail, accuracy and organisational skills.

• Be creative, commercially minded and enthusiastic about marketing.

• Be willing to learn, develop new skills and embrace emerging technologies.

• Be accountable for their performance and the outcomes of their work.

• Understand the importance of professionalism, discretion and patient confidentiality.



Our business rewards team members based on the value they provide. Therefore we will discuss potential remuneration packages during our initial phone interview depending on skills, experience and amount of tasks that can be managed. This way we ensure a fair value exchange is achieved based on what you could bring and the outcomes & expectations of the role.



Key Responsibilities



1. Digital Operations & Administration

- Manage and organise business
 inboxes, prioritise important communications and respond to enquiries professionally and promptly.

- Coordinate practitioner calendars, appointment schedules, meetings and reminders.

- Manage online booking systems, including HotDoc, ensuring appointment availability and booking workflows are accurate and optimised.

- Prepare meeting notes, action items and follow-up communications.

- Provide general administrative and operational support to ensure the smooth running of the clinic's digital systems.



2. Patient Engagement & Lead Management

- Manage incoming patient enquiries across
, website, social media and CRM platforms.

- Respond to prospective and existing patients in a timely, professional and engaging manner.

- Track new leads, manage enquiry pipelines and follow up prospective patients to improve booking conversion.

- Develop and maintain patient communication workflows, including appointment reminders, rebooking, recalls and appropriate post-treatment follow-ups, hotdoc automations

- Support patient retention initiatives, membership programs and skincare replenishment communications.

- Maintain accurate CRM records, including lead sources, enquiry status, patient engagement and relevant segmentation.

- Identify opportunities to improve the patient journey, from initial enquiry through to ongoing care.



3. CRM, Marketing Automation & Technical Systems

- Manage, maintain and optimise CRM platforms, marketing funnels, lead pipelines and automated communication workflows.

- Build and manage
 marketing campaigns, automated sequences and patient engagement communications.

- Develop and maintain landing pages, lead capture forms and associated marketing funnels.

- Configure integrations between website forms, social media advertising, booking systems,
 marketing platforms and CRM software.

- Create and troubleshoot automated workflows using platforms such as GoHighLevel, Zapier or similar systems.

- Manage lead tracking, tagging, segmentation and campaign attribution.

- Regularly review digital systems and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, automation and conversion rates.



4. Social Media, Digital Marketing & Content Creation

- Create, coordinate and schedule engaging, professional and on-brand content across Instagram,
 and other relevant platforms.

- Design social media graphics, educational content, promotional materials and infographics using Canva or similar tools.

- Edit short-form videos and Reels, including trimming footage, adding captions and preparing content for publication.

- Manage social media comments and direct messages, responding to general enquiries and escalating clinical questions appropriately.

- Research relevant marketing trends, content opportunities and audience engagement strategies.

- Coordinate
 newsletters, digital marketing campaigns and promotional communications.

- Support lead generation campaigns, including Meta advertising integrations and lead capture workflows.

- Monitor social media engagement, campaign performance and opportunities to improve reach and conversion.

- Assist in developing patient education materials, treatment information, FAQs and digital resources.



5. Website Management & Digital Optimisation

- Maintain and update website content, including treatment pages, practitioner profiles, pricing, clinic information and educational articles.

- Create and update landing pages to support marketing campaigns and lead generation.

- Regularly test website forms, booking links and online enquiry pathways to ensure a seamless patient experience.

- Assist with search engine optimisation (SEO), website visibility and Google Business Profile management.

- Coordinate basic website maintenance, backups, plugin updates and technical troubleshooting within the scope of their expertise.

- Identify opportunities to improve website usability, patient engagement and enquiry conversion.



6. Data Management, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

- Maintain accurate records of new patient enquiries, bookings, cancellations, rebookings and lead conversions.

- Track key performance indicators across patient acquisition, retention, marketing campaigns and digital engagement.

- Prepare regular reports on appointment activity, revenue performance, enquiry sources and marketing effectiveness.

- Maintain CRM data quality, including contact segmentation, tagging and database organisation.

- Analyse marketing and patient engagement performance to identify opportunities for improvement.

- Proactively research and recommend new technologies, automation tools and systems that could improve operational efficiency and business growth.

- Contribute to the clinic's commitment to innovation, continuous improvement and exceptional patient experiences.



Professional Standards & Patient Confidentiality

As a doctor-led healthcare clinic, patient privacy, professionalism and regulatory compliance are essential.

All patient communications, marketing activities, CRM processes and digital systems must comply with applicable Australian privacy legislation, healthcare advertising requirements and clinic policies.

Clinical enquiries, treatment recommendations and medical decisions must be referred to appropriately qualified practitioners. Marketing and patient education content must undergo the clinic's approval process before publication.



Key Outcomes of the Role



The successful applicant will be responsible for contributing to measurable improvements in:



- New patient enquiry generation and booking conversion.

- Patient engagement, retention and rebooking.

- Digital marketing performance and campaign effectiveness.

- CRM accuracy, automation and operational efficiency.

- Website performance and online booking experience.

- Consistency and quality of digital communications and social media content.

- Overall patient experience and sustainable clinic growth.

title: ESTIMATOR (MUST HAVE MORAWARE.COM EXPERIENCE)
description:

Industry: Stone Benchtops and Construction

Reports To: Sales Manager / Operations Manager



Position Summary

The Estimator is responsible for preparing accurate and timely quotations for stone benchtop and construction projects. The role includes reviewing drawings and specifications, calculating project costs, following up on quotations, converting successful quotes into orders, and providing showroom, sales, and administrative support.



Key Responsibilities

•	Prepare accurate and timely cost estimates and quotations for construction and stone benchtop projects.

•	Review project drawings, specifications, measurements, and material requirements to determine the scope of work.

•	Coordinate with project managers, architects, suppliers, and subcontractors to obtain necessary information.

•	Use estimating software, including Moraware, to prepare and manage quotations.

•	Monitor project costs, identify discrepancies, and ensure pricing accuracy.

2. Sales and Customer Service

•	Attend to client enquiries via phone,
, virtual appointments, and showroom visits.

•	Follow up on active quotations and maintain accurate records of client communications.

•	Convert successful quotations into confirmed orders and ensure all order details are accurate.

•	Respond to concerns and escalate issues when necessary.

•	Act as the first point of contact for general enquiries and direct concerns to the appropriate departments.

3. Product Knowledge and Administration

•	Develop knowledge of company products, materials, and services, including natural stone, porcelain, engineered quartz, and ultra-compact surfaces.

•	Learn the processes involved in stone benchtop measurement, fabrication, and installation.

•	Maintain accurate quotation, order, and client records.

•	Provide general clerical and administrative support as required.



Qualifications and Skills

•	Experience in estimating, construction, sales support, or a related field is preferred.

•	Strong numerical, analytical, and organisational skills.

•	Excellent communication and customer service abilities.

•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and estimating software; Moraware experience is an advantage.

•	Ability to read technical drawings and specifications is desirable.

•	Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

•	Accuracy and timeliness of quotations.

•	Consistent follow-up of active quotations.

•	Conversion of quotations into confirmed orders.

•	Effective cost monitoring and control.

•	Customer satisfaction and response times.

•	Compliance with company SOPs and accurate recordkeeping.



General Responsibilities

•	Maintain confidentiality and comply with company policies and workplace safety requirements.

•	Work collaboratively with internal teams, clients, and suppliers.

•	Perform other reasonable duties as assigned by management.



Position Outcome: To deliver accurate and competitive estimates, support sales growth, provide excellent customer service, and ensure a smooth transition from quotation to confirmed order.

title: Youtube Video Editor - LifeSlyle Travel Channel
description:
We are looking for a creative and reliable YouTube Video Editor to help us build a brand-new family lifestyle YouTube channel.



About Our Channel



Our channel will document our family’s journey toward eventually moving to South Africa from America



We recently took our first family trip to South Africa and have a large amount of video footage that needs to be turned into engaging YouTube content.



Our videos will showcase our real-life journey, including:



Our family travels and experiences in South Africa

Exploring different cities, neighborhoods, and communities

Food, culture, activities, and everyday life

Our experiences traveling as a family

What we are learning about South Africa

The process of preparing for a possible future move

Behind-the-scenes family moments

Our successes, challenges, and experiences along the way



We want the channel to feel authentic, entertaining, personal, and story-driven rather than overly corporate or heavily produced.



What We Need



We are looking for someone who can take our raw footage and turn it into content people actually want to watch.



Your responsibilities may include:



Editing long-form YouTube videos

Creating YouTube Shorts from our footage

Finding the best moments within longer raw video files

Creating strong hooks and intros that keep viewers watching

Adding music, sound effects, transitions, text, captions, B-roll, etc. when appropriate

Improving the pacing and storytelling of our videos

Creating professional, clickable YouTube thumbnails

Organizing footage and completed videos

Making revisions when necessary

BIG PLUS: YouTube Channel Management & Growth Experience



We are especially interested in someone who understands more than just video editing.



If you have experience with growing or managing YouTube channels, please tell us about it.



Experience with any of the following is a big plus:



YouTube SEO

Video titles and descriptions

Thumbnail strategy

Increasing click-through rate (CTR)

Audience retention

YouTube Shorts strategy

Content planning

Studying YouTube analytics

Growing subscribers and views

Understanding what makes lifestyle/travel/family content perform well



Our goal is to find someone who can eventually become an important part of growing the channel with us.



Who We're Looking For



The ideal person is:



Experienced with lifestyle, family, vlog, or travel-style editing

A good storyteller, not just a technical video editor

Creative and able to bring ideas to the table

Good at identifying interesting moments from raw footage

Able to make videos engaging without over-editing them

Reliable and consistent

Good at communicating

Able to meet deadlines

Interested in a long-term working relationship

Comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

Hours & Pay



Starting Pay: $4–$8 USD per hour, depending on experience and skill level.



This will initially be a part-time position, but it has the potential to become full-time for the right person as the channel grows and we produce more content.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us long term.



How to Apply



Please send us:

Your Resume

How many years of video editing experience you have.

Links to 3–5 of your best video editing examples. Lifestyle, family, travel, or vlog examples are preferred.

Examples of YouTube thumbnails you have created.



IMPORTANT: IN THE SUBJECT LINE , write the words “SOUTH AFRICA .”



Applications that do not include those words may not be considered. This helps us identify applicants who actually read the entire job posting.



We already have plenty of footage ready to be edited, so we are looking to get started soon.



If you're creative, understand YouTube storytelling, and would enjoy helping build a family lifestyle/travel channel from the beginning, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Virtual Home Health Quality Assurance Coordinator
description:
Schedule: Monday - Friday, 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM PST (Tuesday–Saturday, 6:00 AM–3:00 PM Philippines Time), with a 1 hour break

Employment: Full-Time, Long-Term Remote Position



A new and growing United States-based, Medicare-certified home health agency, operational for less than one year, is seeking an experienced, organized, and detail-oriented Virtual Home Health Quality Assurance Coordinator.



A clinical background is required for this position.



The ideal candidate will have experience reviewing clinical documentation for a United States-based home health agency and be familiar with the Medicare Conditions of Participation, home health regulatory requirements, and CHAP accreditation standards.



The selected candidate will support the agency’s Quality Assurance and compliance program by reviewing clinical records, identifying documentation deficiencies, monitoring required corrections, and helping ensure that patient records meet Medicare, regulatory, accreditation, and agency standards.



We are seeking a dependable professional who can communicate respectfully with clinicians, manage multiple charts and deadlines, and support the agency’s commitment to quality patient care, regulatory compliance, and survey readiness.



Primary Responsibilities

• Review home health clinical records for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timely submission.

• Review Start of Care, Resumption of Care, Recertification, Transfer, Discharge, and routine visit documentation.

• Review skilled nursing, therapy, medical social work, and home health aide documentation as assigned.

• Review OASIS assessments for completeness and internal consistency.

• Confirm that documentation supports the patient’s skilled need, homebound status, diagnoses, ordered services, and plan of care.

• Review physician orders, plans of care, face-to-face documentation, medication profiles, assessments, and clinical visit notes.

• Identify missing, incomplete, conflicting, vague, late, or potentially noncompliant documentation.

• Review documentation for compliance with applicable Medicare Conditions of Participation, agency policies, and accreditation standards.

• Communicate required documentation corrections clearly, professionally, and respectfully.

• Track outstanding documentation and follow up until corrections are completed.

• Confirm that corrected documentation is appropriately completed, dated, and signed.

• Assist with prebilling clinical record reviews.

• Identify documentation concerns that may affect billing, reimbursement, compliance, or survey readiness.

• Maintain Quality Assurance logs, audit tools, correction trackers, and pending-documentation reports.

• Assist with chart audits, compliance monitoring, quality reports, and performance-improvement activities.

• Support preparation for CHAP accreditation surveys, Medicare reviews, and regulatory audits.

• Identify recurring documentation concerns and recommend areas for clinician education.

• Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA and company privacy requirements.

• Participate in virtual meetings, training, quality initiatives, and workflow-improvement activities.



Required Qualifications

• Clinical background is required.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

• Excellent attention to detail, organization, follow-up, and time-management skills.

• Ability to identify inconsistencies among assessments, physician orders, plans of care, and clinical visit documentation.

• Ability to communicate clinical documentation concerns professionally and respectfully.

• Ability to manage multiple charts, clinicians, deadlines, and competing priorities.

• Proficiency with electronic medical records,
, spreadsheets, virtual meeting platforms, and document-management systems.

• Ability to work independently while remaining responsive and accountable to agency leadership.

• Reliable computer, secure high-speed internet connection, quiet workspace, backup internet, and backup power source.

• Availability to work full-time during California Pacific Time business hours.



Preferred Experience 

The following experience is strongly preferred:

•	Previous experience with a United States-based Medicare-certified home health agency.

•	Experience with the Medicare Conditions of Participation for Home Health Agencies.

•	Familiarity with federal and state home health regulatory requirements.

•	Experience with CHAP accreditation standards or accreditation survey preparation.

•	Home health Quality Assurance, clinical documentation review, utilization review, compliance, case management, or chart-auditing experience.

•	Familiarity with OASIS assessments, physician orders, plans of care, face-to-face documentation, homebound status, and skilled-need requirements.

•	Experience reviewing nursing, therapy, and other interdisciplinary clinical documentation.

•	Experience with prebilling clinical reviews and documentation-correction tracking.

•	Knowledge of survey readiness, audit preparation, and performance-improvement processes.

•	Experience in ADR, Medicare audits, Synergy, and Joint Commission documentation.



Applicants with a strong clinical background and home health experience may be considered when they demonstrate the ability and willingness to learn specific Medicare and CHAP requirements.



Preferred Candidate 

The preferred candidate will be:

•	Experienced in United States home health Quality Assurance.

•	Knowledgeable about Medicare home health documentation and compliance requirements.

•	Familiar with OASIS assessments, plans of care, physician orders, and clinical visit documentation.

•	Experienced in ADR, Medicare audits, Synergy, and Joint Commission documentation.

•	Able to provide clear, accurate, and respectful feedback to clinicians.

•	Organized, efficient, dependable, and able to meet established deadlines.

•	Proactive in identifying documentation risks and following through until concerns are resolved.

•	Comfortable communicating with nurses, therapists, physicians, office staff, and agency leadership.

•	Interested in helping a new agency establish strong and sustainable Quality Assurance processes.



Compensation and Benefits

• Starting compensation of $10.00 USD per hour.

• Three paid holidays selected by the employee, subject to advance approval and appropriate staffing coverage.

• A December bonus equivalent to one month of regular base compensation, subject to satisfactory performance, active employment, and company policy.

• Eligibility for paid vacation after completing one full year of service.

• Eligibility for a compensation review after one year based on performance, attendance, reliability, expanded responsibilities, and the financial performance of the company.

• Training and professional growth opportunities as the agency expands.



How to Apply

Please submit the following materials to 

• A current résumé.

• A brief summary of your clinical background.

• A summary of your United States home health experience.

• Details regarding your experience with Quality Assurance, chart review, OASIS, clinical documentation, or regulatory compliance.

• A summary of your experience with Medicare Conditions of Participation or accreditation standards.

• A list of the home health electronic medical record systems you have used.

• Confirmation that you are available to work full-time during California Pacific Time business hours.

• Information regarding your computer, internet connection, backup internet, and backup power source.

• A brief explanation of why you are a strong candidate for this position.



Qualified applicants may be invited to participate in a virtual interview and complete a brief Quality Assurance or clinical documentation skills assessment.



We are committed to building a professional, collaborative, and supportive team. We value clinical accuracy, accountability, compliance, respectful communication, teamwork, and excellent patient care.



Compensation, benefits, work schedule, employment classification, bonus eligibility, and other terms will be confirmed in the final written agreement and administered in accordance with company policy and applicable requirements.

 Requirements

title: Interior Designer
description:

title: Business Operations Manager
description:
Operations Manager – Business Operations & Systems (experience in Property Development)



About the Role



Send your CV to 



We are looking for a hands-on Operations Manager part time 20 to 30 hrs per week who will take ownership of the day-to-day operations of the business and help build the systems, structure, and processes needed for sustainable growth.



This role will work closely with the business owner to organize, systemize, and improve the business. You will manage Virtual Assistants (VAs), create workflows and SOPs, improve how work moves across the business, and identify opportunities to increase efficiency, capacity, and profitability.



The ideal candidate is someone who does not simply manage what already exists. You should be comfortable looking at a business and asking:



**“How can we make this more organized, efficient, scalable, and easier to manage?”**



You will be expected to identify gaps, create practical solutions, implement them, and continuously improve the way the business operates.



Key Responsibilities



Business Operations Management



* Manage and oversee the day-to-day operations of the business.

* Work closely with the business owner to translate business goals into clear operational plans.

* Establish structure, accountability, priorities, and processes across the business.

* Monitor workloads, deadlines, priorities, and overall team capacity.

* Identify operational gaps, bottlenecks, and inefficiencies and implement solutions.

* Ensure that tasks and responsibilities have clear owners and deadlines.

* Create visibility across the business through trackers, dashboards, reports, and regular updates.

* Help the business owner spend less time managing day-to-day tasks and more time focusing on growth.



Systemization & Process Improvement



* Review the current way the business operates and identify areas that need structure.

* Design and implement efficient workflows for recurring business activities.

* Map out processes from start to finish and identify opportunities for improvement.

* Create systems that reduce dependency on the business owner.

* Standardize recurring tasks and ensure they can be delegated effectively.

* Identify repetitive manual processes that can be automated.

* Continuously review and improve operational systems as the business grows.



 SOP Development & Documentation



* Create, organize, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

* Turn existing knowledge and informal processes into clear, documented procedures.

* Develop step-by-step guides, checklists, templates, and workflows.

* Ensure SOPs are easy for VAs and new team members to understand and follow.

* Regularly review and update documentation as processes change.

* Build an organized central repository for business processes and documentation.



GoHighLevel / CRM & Automation



* Manage and optimize the company's **GoHighLevel (GHL)** system.

* Build and maintain pipelines, workflows, automations, forms, calendars, and triggers.

* Create processes for lead management, follow-ups, onboarding, client communication, and other business activities.

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive administrative and operational tasks.

* Ensure the CRM is properly maintained and consistently used by the team.

* Troubleshoot workflow and automation issues.

* Continuously look for ways GHL and other technology can improve efficiency and support business growth.



Business Growth & Scalability



* Work with the owner to identify opportunities to improve and grow the business.

* Help build operational capacity as the business increases its clients, revenue, and team size.

* Identify processes that need to change before the business reaches its next stage of growth.

* Recommend tools, systems, resources, or staffing changes when appropriate.

* Help improve productivity and profitability through better processes and resource allocation.

* Support the development of scalable systems that allow the business to grow without creating unnecessary operational complexity.



Performance & Reporting



* Establish meaningful operational KPIs and performance measures.

* Track team productivity, workload, delivery, and business performance.

* Prepare regular operational updates and reports for the business owner.

* Highlight risks, bottlenecks, opportunities, and areas requiring attention.

* Use data to identify trends and support business decisions.



Requirements



* 5+ years of experience in Operations Management, Business Operations, or a similar role.**

* Proven experience managing remote teams or Virtual Assistants.

* Strong experience creating **SOPs, workflows, processes, and operational systems**.

* Experience organizing and systemizing a growing business.

* **Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) is required.**

* Strong understanding of CRM systems, workflows, pipelines, and automation.

* Experience managing team performance and accountability.

* Strong problem-solving and process improvement skills.

* Excellent organizational and project management skills.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Comfortable working directly with a business owner/founder.

* Able to work independently and take ownership without constant supervision.

* Strong attention to detail and follow-through.



### Preferred Experience



* Experience working with small or growing businesses.

* Experience building operational systems from the ground up.

* Experience with automation and AI tools.



* Experience working with international clients.



### The Right Person for This Role



We are looking for someone who is:



**A Builder** – You enjoy creating structure where there isn't much structure yet.



**A Problem Solver** – You don't just identify problems; you figure out how to fix them.



**A Systems Thinker** – You naturally look for ways to turn repetitive work into documented processes, workflows, and automation.



**A People Manager** – You can manage VAs, set expectations, coach performance, and hold people accountable.



**A Self-Starter** – You don't need to be told what to do every day. You can identify what needs to be done and take action.



**Business-Minded** – You understand that operations should support revenue, client satisfaction, profitability, and growth.



**Tech-Savvy** – You are comfortable working with CRM systems, automation, AI tools, and business technology.



Send your CV to

title: Real Estate Listing Officer / Customer Service
description:

Position Overview



The Property Listing Officer is responsible for securing, documenting, verifying, managing, marketing, and optimizing all property listings (individual & corporate).

title: Record Half-Body Videos (Face, Voice & Hand Gestures) for AI Avatar Training
description:
We are collecting short videos of real people to train our own AI avatar model. You will record yourself expressing emotions with your face, voice and hand gestures.



VIDEO RULES

- 20 to 60 seconds per video

- ONE emotion per video, never mixed

- No script. Imagine a situation for the emotion and talk naturally in your own words, in any language



EMOTIONS (23)

Neutral, Happy, Excited, Sad, Angry, Fearful, Surprised, Disgusted, Confused, Curious, Concerned, Embarrassed, Proud, Relieved, Disappointed, Frustrated, Amused, Nervous, Serious, Confident, Skeptical, Empathetic, Anxious



RECORDING GUIDELINES

- Half-body framing: top of your head to your waist

- Natural hand gestures, both hands visible the whole time

- Eyes on the camera for the entire video

- Clear audio: quiet room, no background noise, music, TV or fan

- Plain background, only you in the frame

- 1080p or higher, phone on a tripod or stable surface



VIDEO VALIDATION

We have a website that validates every video, and our team also reviews videos manually. Any part of a video is rejected if:

- you are not making eye contact with the camera

- your hands are not visible

- more than one person appears

- there is background noise, or the video is blurry



Example: you upload a 30-second video and 20 seconds are usable. You are paid for those 20 seconds only.



We share the website link after you are hired, once your sample video meets our requirements.



PAYMENT

- $30 per usable hour of VIDEO ($0.50 per usable minute), not per hour of work

- Paid through platform milestones. We fund a small milestone before the main recordings. The money is held by the platform and released after your videos are checked



IMPORTANT

- Only your own original recordings. Movie clips, edited or AI-generated videos will get your account banned

- You must be 18 or older

- You will sign a consent form allowing your recordings (face and voice) to be used to train our AI avatar model



TO APPLY

Send a 20-second sample video showing ONE emotion (Happy): imagine you just heard some very good news and talk about it naturally. Follow all the guidelines above.



Also tell us:

1. Language(s) you will speak

2. Phone or camera you will use

3. Minutes of video you can deliver per week

title: Social Media Manager & Brand Operator — Ambient Lounge Europe (AI-Native Role)
description:
Soft Luxury e-commerce brand. Speak every language (with the help of AI).



Ambient Lounge® is a Melbourne-born soft-luxury furniture brand with over 21 years of design history. We make rebound foam sofa, designer bean bags, outdoor sofas and pet beds, sold across Australia, New Zealand & Europe. Our pieces live in beautiful homes, on sun-drenched terraces and in the pages of design magazines.



We’re looking for someone special to become the social & customer voice of Ambient Lounge Europe (ambientlounge.eu), with a creative eye across our Australian brands too.



This isn’t a “post three times a week” job. You’ll be part creative director, part community manager & part operator. You’ll make our socials feel like a stylish European interiors magazine that people actually want to follow. You’ll do it in French, German and other European languages, using AI as your daily creative partner.



This role is built for the AI era.



Five years ago, this job probably needed someone fluent in five languages. Today it needs someone fluent in AI. If you know how to prompt Claude and ChatGPT to write a caption that sounds natively French, reply to a German customer with warmth and precision, and then check that it truly lands, you can do something incredible here. If that idea excites you rather than scares you, keep reading.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



✦ Own Ambient Lounge Europe’s social presence. You’ll plan, create and publish content across Instagram,
, TikTok, Pinterest and wherever our customers are scrolling next.



✦ Create content that looks like it belongs in a design magazine. That means Reels, carousels, stories, lifestyle edits, product moments, trend-led videos and captions with real style.



✦ Work multilingually with AI every single day. You’ll write, translate, localise and quality-check content and customer replies in French, German and other European languages using Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools.



✦ Monitor and manage our community. You’ll respond to comments, DMs and customer enquiries across platforms and languages, quickly, warmly and on-brand.



✦ Keep an eye across the family. You’ll support content and monitoring for our Australian brands (
, 
 and more) as needed.



✦ Build smarter systems. You’ll create AI workflows, content calendars, prompt libraries and templates so we get faster and better every month.



✦ Watch the numbers. You’ll track what’s working using our analytics tools, report back, and double down on what performs.



✦ Spot trends early. You’ll bring us ideas from European interiors, pet culture, outdoor living and design TikTok before everyone else is doing them.



WHO YOU ARE



✦ You use AI daily. Not “I tried ChatGPT once,” but you genuinely build, prompt, refine and experiment with Claude, ChatGPT and AI image/video tools.



✦ You hopefully have proven social media experience managing brand accounts, ideally in lifestyle, fashion, interiors, beauty or ecommerce.



✦ You have taste. You know the difference between content that looks cheap and content that looks premium, and you care deeply about that difference.



✦ You’re excited by languages and confident using AI to work in them. Any existing European language skills are a big bonus.



✦ You have excellent written English with a warm, polished, slightly playful tone.



✦ You’re comfortable with Canva, CapCut or similar, plus scheduling tools like Metricool or Meta Business Suite.



✦ You’re proactive. You wake up with ideas, you don’t wait to be told, and you take ownership.



✦ You want a long-term home. Our Philippines team has been with us for over 12 years, and we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us.



Bonus points for: TikTok Shop or Instagram Shopping experience, Shopify, customer service background, photography/styling instincts, or a love of dogs and cats (our pet beds are a big part of our world).



WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT HERE



✦ A design-led international brand with real heritage and a real point of view

✦ Creative ownership of an entire European brand presence

✦ You’ll work at the cutting edge of AI in ecommerce, and we’ll invest in your skills

✦ A founder who loves AI and will build alongside you

✦ A loyal, long-standing Philippines team

✦ Long-term stability with genuine growth opportunities



HOW TO APPLY



We read every application. To show us you’ve read this one properly:

title: Home Care Recruiter
description:
Home Care Recruiter — High Volume | Remote (Philippines) OPA Home Care & Skilled Nursing | Full-Time | Remote



What this role is?



OPA Home Care & Skilled Nursing is a fast-growing private home care company in the Atlanta metro area. We operate on one standard: zero missed shifts. Recruiting is what makes that possible.



This is a production role. You will own Stages 1 and 2 of our hiring pipeline — from first contact to behavioral screen — and you will be measured on daily output, not activity.



If you are looking for a sourcing or resume-review role, this is not it. If you move fast, follow a process without being told twice, and are comfortable disqualifying candidates who do not meet the bar, keep reading.



What you will do?



Monitor inbound applications from ZipRecruiter and Indeed. Every applicant receives a response the same business day — 48 hours is the ceiling, not the target. Contact sequence is non-negotiable: digital message, phone call (two attempts), follow-up
. Every action logged in AxisCare. If it is not in the system, it did not happen.



When you reach a candidate, you are not screening — you are recruiting. Lead with who OPA is and why it is a good opportunity. Then confirm licensure (CNA, HHA, PCA, LPN, Med Tech, or RN), schedule availability, ability to start within 7 days, and willingness to go through our on-call integration period. Candidates who do not answer the phone, do not respond within 48 hours, or do not meet the basic requirements are disqualified. No second chances, no exceptions.



Candidates who pass your call are directed to complete a behavioral phone screen as their next step. You track completion and process outcomes. Advancing candidates receive a call from you within two hours and a credentialing
 the same day.



You will report daily metrics to our operations coordinator and maintain accurate pipeline status in AxisCare at all times.



What we are looking for



You have at least two years of high-volume recruiting experience in home care, healthcare staffing, or a high-output BPO environment. You have made a lot of outbound calls and you are comfortable doing it. Your English is strong enough to represent OPA professionally on a live call. You have worked in a CRM or ATS and you understand that logging is not optional.



Experience recruiting U.S. caregivers specifically — CNA, HHA, PCA, LPN, or RN — is a strong advantage. Familiarity with ZipRecruiter and Indeed pipelines is preferred.



More important than any credential: you respond fast, you follow a process without drifting from it, you are comfortable saying no to candidates who do not qualify, and you take accountability for your numbers.



Include your resume when applying.

title: Instagram Content Editor & Paid Ads Specialist | UAE-Based Preferred
description:
Instagram Content Editor & Paid Ads Specialist (Remote)



Location: Remote · Must overlap with Abu Dhabi hours (GST / UTC+4)  

Type: Ongoing, part-time with potential to grow into full-time  

Budget: From $500/month, depending on experience and scope



## About the Role



We are a children's sports academy in Abu Dhabi with several locations. Our Instagram account is already established and active — we are not starting from zero, and we are not asking you to rebuild anything.



We film in-house. Our team shoots at the gym every week, so you will always have fresh footage to work with. You do not need to be based in Abu Dhabi.



We need someone who can turn that footage into content that attracts parents and generates bookings.



**Two priorities. Everything else is secondary.**



### 1. Editing



You take raw class footage and turn it into Reels that capture attention and keep people watching until the end. This is the single most important skill in this role. If your editing is strong, we can work around the rest.



### 2. Paid Ads and Lead Generation



You run Meta ads that generate bookings for our free trial lessons, and you can show us what a lead costs.



## Important: Our Audience Is Adults



Our content features children, but our audience is their parents.



That distinction influences everything — pacing, music, text, tone, what you cut, and what you keep. We are looking for someone who understands how to create content for adults making decisions about their children, not content that looks like it was made for kids.



If you have created content for parents or families before, please mention it in your application.



## What You Will Do



- Edit Reels using raw footage we provide.

- Plan and publish a consistent flow of posts, Stories, and Reels. Our account should never go quiet.

- Follow our existing brand book and visual guidelines.

- Create simple Canva graphics for schedules, announcements, competition results, coach profiles, and other updates.

- Set up, manage, and optimise Meta ads focused on generating trial lesson bookings.

- Provide weekly reports covering published content, performance, ad spend, cost per lead, and upcoming plans.



**Platforms:** Instagram and
 are the priorities. TikTok is secondary. YouTube is not in scope for now.



## What Success Looks Like



- Content is delivered on time every week, without repeated follow-ups.

- Reels hold viewers' attention and generate saves, not just views.

- Paid ads generate relevant leads and trial lesson bookings.

- Cost per booked trial lesson improves over time.

- Our account grows its real, relevant audience in Abu Dhabi.



Specific targets will be agreed upon during the first month.



## Requirements



### Essential



- Strong short-form video editing skills. You must show Reels you personally edited, not just work produced by your team.

- Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, including real advertising budgets and measurable results.

- Strong written English for parent-facing captions and communication.

- Reliable weekly availability and a clear response time during Abu Dhabi hours.



### Desirable



- Canva design skills.

- Experience with lead generation or working alongside a sales team.

- Experience with children's sports, gymnastics, dance, education, or family-focused brands.

- Arabic language skills.



## One Thing We Ask You to Be Honest About



We understand that good specialists manage several accounts. That is normal, and we are fine with it.



What we are not fine with is being the account that gets done last.



Please tell us how many accounts you currently manage and how you organise your workload to protect deadlines. A clear, realistic answer counts in your favour.



## How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. **One Reel you personally edited** and a brief explanation of why you think it worked.

2. **Two or three accounts you currently manage or have worked on**, with links and a description of your specific responsibilities for each.

3. **One paid campaign you personally managed**, including the budget, results, and cost per lead.

4. **Your toolkit and workflow:** What tools do you use for editing and design? Briefly explain how you work from raw footage to a published Reel.

5. **Your current workload and availability:** How many accounts do you manage, and how many hours per week can you commit to this role?

6. **Your rate:** Your monthly rate and what is included.



## Test Task



Shortlisted candidates will receive a folder containing our actual footage and a short creative brief.



You will be asked to create:

- One Instagram Reel.

- One set of Instagram Stories.



**Applications without at least one Reel personally edited by the applicant will not be reviewed.**

title: Engineering Team Coordinator (Delivery & Execution)

Execution Quality Gates

• Reject work that: contains implicit decisions, lacks acceptance criteria, introduces duplication without approval

• Ensure QA does not compensate for missing engineering clarity



Decision Discipline (in partnership with TPM / Product)

• Require explicit tracking of: Open Decisions, Frozen Decisions

• Block execution on unresolved architectural decisions

• Ensure decisions are made by the right group, at the right time

• Prevent “decision by implementation”



5. Engineering Standards Enforcement

• Treat violations as delivery risk, not personal issues

Required Skills & Traits



Must Have

• Comfort enforcing rules and saying “no”

● Understanding of DFM/DFA for manufacturing (injection molding, machining, sheet metal) and material selection 

(including biocompatibility).

● Experience managing engineering projects—timelines, scope, tracking.

● Strong English communication skills—you'll be speaking directly with US clients.

● Experience leading or mentoring a small engineering team.

● Able to work US Mountain Time business hours.



Nice to Have

● Background in consulting or professional services

● Knowledge of FDA 510(k) submissions and ISO 13485



Why Work With Us

● Long-term, stable contract, not a short gig.

About the role



We are looking for a curious, dependable and highly organized Sales Operations Support Coordinator to help keep our sales team running smoothly.



This role combines sales administration, process compliance, product training coordination and recruitment support. You will be trusted to follow tasks through from beginning to end, ask thoughtful questions when something is unclear and ensure that no detail is overlooked.



This position is ideal for someone who takes genuine pride in their work. You should be willing to help wherever reasonably required and understand that both small administrative tasks and larger projects contribute to the success of the team.



As our business evolves, you will also be expected to learn new areas and take ownership of agreed projects and reasonable duties across the wider business. This is a varied role for someone who is adaptable, willing to contribute wherever needed and equally committed to routine responsibilities and larger projects.



Key responsibilities

* Sales processes and compliance

* Conduct regular checks to ensure the sales team follows established standard operating procedures.

* Maintain clear checklists and records of completed compliance checks.

* Identify missing steps, documentation or follow-ups and address them promptly.

* Follow each matter through to completion rather than assuming someone else will finish it.

* Provide concise updates to management on recurring issues and areas requiring attention.

* Suggest practical process improvements when gaps or inefficiencies are identified.



Product training and knowledge base

* Prepare and organize training materials for new products.

* Upload, structure and maintain content in Zoho Learn.

* Keep the company knowledge base accurate, current and easy to navigate.

* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to obtain product files, specifications, images and other required information.

* Track outstanding information and follow up until it is received.

* Ask questions and confirm expectations whenever instructions or product information are unclear.



Recruitment support

* Review applications against agreed selection criteria.

* Conduct initial candidate screening by
, phone or video call.

Daily roster and attendance support

* Record exceptions accurately and follow the appropriate escalation process.

* Communicate reminders professionally, consistently and fairly.

Projects and evolving priorities

* Take ownership of new operational projects and change business priorities as assigned by management.

* Clarify the required outcome, scope, priority, deadline and stakeholders before commencing unfamiliar work.

* Turn instructions into a practical action plan with clear steps, responsibilities and due dates.

* Coordinate with internal team members, suppliers or other stakeholders as required.

* Ask questions and raise potential obstacles early rather than making assumptions or waiting until a deadline is missed.

General Operations:

* Analyzing information and preparing useful reports.

* Creates clear handover notes and ensures essential processes are covered before taking leave.

* Is honest, genuine and trustworthy in their communication and work.

* Accepts feedback positively and applies it to future work.

* Closes the loop by confirming when work has been completed.



Skills and experience

* At least two years’ experience in sales administration, operations support, recruitment coordination or a similar role.
