title: Head of Growth & Operations - Competitions & Gambling Head Wanted
description:
Head of Growth & Operations



Online Prize Competitions | Social Media | Community | Sales



- AI Applications will be immediately rejected.



- Please read carefully and answer the questions at the end.



We are looking for:



- Senior staff with experience in Competitions / Gambling community management.



- A highly motivated and ambitions individual who wants to earn western wages via percentage % of a highly profitable UK business.



- A pro-active individual who can run the online operations of the business independantly without constant guidance. 



We’re looking for an exceptional Head of Growth & Operations to take ownership of the day-to-day growth of a fast-moving UK online prize competition brand.



This is not a standard Social Media Manager role.



We need someone who can become the operational heartbeat of the business — constantly engaging our audience, driving activity, managing our promotional teams and making sure that the attention we generate actually turns into customers and sales.



Think of yourself as the catcher’s mitt for all of our marketing.



We’ll be generating traffic through paid advertising, influencers, video content, live streams and real-world activations. Your job is to make sure there is an extremely active operation behind that traffic — engaging people, building excitement, answering questions, creating content and ultimately converting attention into sales.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



You’ll take ownership of our day-to-day organic growth and community operation, including:



Managing our
, Instagram, TikTok and WhatsApp

Creating, scheduling and publishing content throughout the day

Creating and improving on daily promotional schedules & engagement drivers

Managing and growing our
 groups and online communities

Responding to comments, messages and customer interactions

Starting conversations rather than simply waiting for them

Creating excitement around competitions, prizes, winners and launches

Turning social engagement into website traffic and sales

Identifying opportunities to re-engage previous customers

Coming up with new promotions, campaigns and engagement ideas

Spotting trends and reacting to them quickly





Managing Our People



This isn't just a content position.



You'll also help manage and motivate the people responsible for growing the brand, including:



Promoters

Recruiters

Affiliates

Influencers

Content creators

Virtual assistants and support staff



You’ll make sure people know what they should be doing, follow up on performance and keep the entire operation moving.



We don't want someone who needs to be given a task list every morning.



We want someone who creates the task list.



Community ? Engagement ? Sales





The Person We're Looking For



You'll probably be a very good fit if you are:



Extremely proactive

Operates with intensity

Money & results driven

Experienced in Competitions / Raffles

Highly organised

Naturally confident online

A strong written communicator

Experienced with social media and community management

Comfortable managing multiple people and priorities

Able to create engaging social content yourself

Familiar with TikTok, Instagram Reels and short-form video

Comfortable looking at numbers and understanding what is driving sales

Capable of managing remote staff and holding people accountable

Fast-moving and comfortable making decisions

Full of ideas rather than waiting for instructions



Most importantly, you need to understand social media.



You should understand why people comment, share, buy, participate and come back.



This Is NOT a Traditional 9–5 Social Media Job



Our business lives online.



That doesn't mean we expect somebody to sit at a desk 24 hours a day, but we do need someone who naturally understands that social media and online communities don't simply switch off at 5pm.



We're looking for someone who enjoys being connected, seeing what's happening and keeping momentum going.



What Success Looks Like



Within this role, we want to see:



Thousands of customers active daily engaging in our communities

Consistent daily social activity

Fast responses to customers

Rocketing organic reach

More website traffic from social media

Better-performing promoters and recruiters

Increased repeat customers

Higher customer engagement

More creative campaigns

Ultimately, increased sales



You'll have significant freedom to experiment, build systems and develop new ideas.



You'll own what happens when the users connect to our socials.



Your job is to make sure we're building a community around the brand, keeping customers engaged and creating an operation capable of converting increasing amounts of attention into revenue.



This Role Has Room to Grow



We're looking for somebody who can eventually become one of the most important people in the company.



For the right person, there is significant scope to grow the position, build your own team and take increasing responsibility for the day-to-day operation of the business.



If you're the type of person who sees a quiet
 group and immediately starts thinking about how to make it active again — we want to hear from you.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS:



1. What experience do you have in the gambling / competition niche? Please give as much information as possible.



2. What experience do you have managing the operations and community of a business or brand? Please go into detail.



3. Can you please provide specific links (GoogleDrive, Drop box) of content you have made for businesses social media?



4. Do you have experience running online teams? If so, please provide detailed experience. How was this done? How did you communicate? What was the end goal?



-- AI Applications are very obvious and will be immediately rejected.



-- I need to see your real English skills, as we will voice call frequently.



This is for highly motivated and experienced individuals that want to earn high end western wages, remotely.



This is a job with huge growth potential that we hope you have the ambition to grow into.



--



Please reply with your WHATSAPP number as that is where the team will reach out to you.



Immediate Starts Available

title: Phone Appointment Setter
description:
About ArchiTreasure Design

ArchiTreasure Design is a U.S.-based, fully remote renovation design and visualization studio. We help homeowners and real estate investors plan renovations with confidence through layouts and space planning, measured plans, and clear final renderings of the finished design. We also provide white-label visualization for architects and contractors who have plans but no in-house rendering capability. Clients can start from plans, sketches, photos, or a scan of an existing space. Our approach is simple: Confidence before construction. Learn more at 
.



The Role

We are hiring a dependable, self-directed phone professional to find potential clients online, call them, and book consultation appointments with our founder. This is an outbound phone role. Your goal is booked appointments. You will not be closing sales or discussing detailed pricing.

You will work from written scripts and call guidelines that we supply. We provide a VoIP phone line and training on our process, services, and target clients.



Responsibilities

• Research and identify potential business clients through web searches, including general contractors, remodelers, architects, designers, and real estate investors.

• Call prospects using our approved scripts, introduce ArchiTreasure Design clearly and professionally, and invite qualified prospects to book a free consultation.

• Follow up by phone with leads generated by our marketing campaigns, including homeowner leads who have already requested information from us.

• Handle common questions and objections using approved talking points, and pass anything outside the script to the founder.

• Book appointments through our scheduling tool (Calendly) within the availability we confirm.

• Log every prospect, call outcome, and next step accurately in our tracking system.

• Report daily or weekly on calls made, conversations held, appointments booked, and leads found.

• Follow all U.S. calling regulations, including Do-Not-Call and consent rules, and never misrepresent who you are, who you represent, or what we offer.



Requirements

• At least one year of outbound phone experience with U.S. clients, such as appointment setting, B2B or sales development, lead generation, or telemarketing.

• Fluent, clear spoken English with a professional, confident phone presence. All calls are in English.

• Strong written English for notes, follow-up messages, and reporting.

• Comfort with online research and the ability to find business owners and decision-makers on your own.

• Resilience, discipline, and the ability to handle rejection and stay consistent without close supervision.

• Accurate notetaking and willingness to follow written scripts and procedures.

• Experience with VoIP phone systems or CRMs is helpful but not required.



Equipment and Work Setup

• A reliable computer or laptop.

• A quality headset with a clear microphone.

• Stable high-speed internet that can run VoIP calls without dropping, with a backup connection (such as mobile data) and a plan for power outages.

• A quiet workspace with no background noise during calls.



Schedule

• Monday–Friday, 9:00 am–5:00 pm U.S. Central Time.

• This is an overnight shift in the Philippines, approximately 9:00 pm–6:00 am Philippine time (11:00 pm–7:00 am when U.S. daylight saving time ends). Please apply only if this schedule works for you.

Compensation

• $75 USD per week ($300 per month), paid weekly.

• This is an independent contractor role. You are responsible for your own taxes and any government contributions required in your country.

• The first 30 days are a paid trial. We will review results and fit together before continuing the arrangement.



How to Apply

Please include all of the following:

1. Your resume, with a brief description of your outbound phone experience with U.S. clients.

2. A two- to three-minute English voice recording in which you introduce yourself and demonstrate a cold call to a general contractor, inviting them to a free consultation about photorealistic renovation renderings. This is a fictional scenario, and you may use your own words.

3. A short, written answer (a paragraph or two): how would you find and qualify contractors and real estate investors online?

4. Your results, if you have them. If you cite a booking or conversion rate, include the time period and the number of calls or leads measured.

5. A description of your workspace, computer, headset, internet connection, and backup internet and power.

6. Your earliest start date, and confirmation that you can work the full schedule above.



Make sure any resume or recording links can be opened by our team.



Send your application to 
 with the subject line: Appointment Setter | [Your Name]

title: Cold Calling Appointment Setter: US Small Businesses (Full-Time, US Hours)
description:
Atomic Finch builds websites for small local businesses in Colorado (plumbers, salons, restaurants,

auto shops) and then helps them get found on Google. We build the site first, free, then show it to

the owner. Your job is to call business owners, tell them we've built them something, and book a

You will:

English; a quiet room, a headset, and reliable internet with a backup. We're looking for candidates who have previous experience working with a digital marketing agency, as the position requires familiarity with digital marketing services and communicating their value to business owners.



Schedule: full-time, Monday to Friday, US Mountain business hours.



Pay: Basic pay + Commission

title: Remote Commercial Energy Efficiency & HVAC Specialist
description:
Job Summary:





We are seeking a highly skilled and high-integrity Remote Commercial Energy Efficiency & HVAC Specialist with 3–5 years of relevant experience to evaluate commercial HVAC and mechanical systems and identify opportunities for energy efficiency and cost savings. The ideal candidate will have strong technical knowledge of commercial HVAC systems, boilers, high-efficiency boiler upgrades, and domestic hot water systems/tanks, as well as an understanding of energy-efficiency technologies and upgrades. This role will be responsible for assessing existing systems, recommending equipment replacements and retrofits, analyzing energy savings and financial returns, and ensuring proposed projects meet applicable technical and program requirements. The specialist will also support utility rebate and government energy-efficiency programs by reviewing project documentation, equipment specifications, and incentive eligibility, and preparing accurate project reports and documentation. The successful candidate should be analytical, resourceful, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment while maintaining strong communication with clients, vendors, and internal teams. Proficiency in English, Microsoft Office, and Excel, along with the ability to quickly learn new systems and workflows, is required.



Key Responsibilities:



Evaluate commercial HVAC systems, including chillers, RTUs, VRF systems, controls, and building automation.

Assess commercial boilers, high-efficiency boiler upgrades, and domestic hot water systems/tanks.

Identify energy-saving opportunities and recommend equipment replacements, retrofits, and system improvements.

Analyze energy savings, payback periods, ROI, lifecycle costs, and available incentives.

Apply utility rebate and government energy-efficiency program requirements.

Review proposed projects and equipment for technical and program compliance.

Review technical documentation, equipment specifications, and project proposals.

Prepare project documentation and reports for energy-efficiency programs and incentives.

Perform other duties related to the position as assigned.

Proficient level of English (written and spoken).

Strong interpersonal and communication skills with clients, vendors, and teammates.

3–5 years of experience in commercial HVAC, mechanical engineering/consulting, energy auditing, energy efficiency, or a related field.

Strong knowledge of commercial HVAC and mechanical systems.

Experience with commercial boilers and high-efficiency boiler upgrades.

Experience with domestic hot water systems/tanks.

Ability to interpret mechanical plans and technical specifications.

Strong Excel, analytical, and reporting skills.

Knowledge of utility rebates and government energy-efficiency incentive programs.

Resourceful, high level of integrity, accountable, with a strong sense of ownership.

Out-of-the-box thinker, highly adaptable, reliable, self-motivated, and confident.

Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently.

Strong attention to detail and multitasking skills in fast-paced work environments.

Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage daily operations.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

Familiar with standard business tools 
, spreadsheets, document management).

Ability to follow established processes accurately with minimal supervision.

Ability to work U.S. EST (New York) business hours and adapt to business needs.

Interested in long-term career opportunities.

Reliable Windows 10+ computer, two monitors, and high-speed internet.

Professional home workstation capable of supporting uninterrupted remote work.



Compensation & Benefits:

title: Finance & Billing Specialist
description:
Job Title: Finance & Billing Specialist (Full-Time)

Company: A Kind Heart Healthcare Services (akindheart./info/)



About Us:

A Kind Heart Healthcare Services is a growing U.S.-based home care agency providing non-medical support services to seniors and individuals needing assistance at home. We are currently expanding our operations into new states and require a dedicated finance professional to maintain the integrity of our billing and payroll systems.



We are looking for a trustworthy, tech-savvy, and communicative individual to own our finance and billing cycle. This role is ideal for an organized professional looking for a dedicated, long-term role within a collaborative, high-energy team.



Important Note:

Applicants without prior experience in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and healthcare-related billing/invoicing should not apply. We are specifically seeking candidates with proven experience in this type of work to ensure quality and reliability in our financial operations.



Responsibilities:



• End-to-End Billing: Manage the full invoice lifecycle, including the accurate generation and distribution of client invoices.

Payroll Processing: Support payroll workflows using AxisCare, CareScout, and QBO.

• System Synchronization: Trigger and monitor the data flow between AxisCare, CareScout, and QBO; perform routine reconciliations to ensure audit-readiness.

• Client Communication: Monitor the 
 inbox and respond to client inquiries and concerns using our provided "sincere & humanized" communication templates.

• Collaboration: Be an active, engaged participant on MS Teams. Provide proactive updates, communicate clearly about task statuses, and be ready to huddle to resolve financial discrepancies.

• Documentation: Maintain accurate financial records and support documentation workflows using Monday./com.



Required Skills:



• Technical Proficiency: You are tech-savvy, comfortable learning new software, and have strong hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online (QBO).

• Healthcare Finance: Experience with home care payroll or Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) platforms (e.g., AxisCare) is a major advantage.

• CareScout Experience: Familiarity with CareScout is highly preferred.

• Billing Experience: Proven experience in invoice generation and healthcare/home care billing operations.

• Communication Pro: You love to communicate! You are active on MS Teams, provide proactive updates, and are committed to maintaining our brand’s sincere tone when resolving client concerns.

• Reliability: You are disciplined in meeting deadlines.

• Process-Driven: You love using project management tools (like Monday./com) to keep tasks organized and transparent.

• Autonomy: Ability to follow SOP-based workflows, manage time effectively, and work independently.



Good to Know:



• On-Demand Pay: We utilize TapCheck for our caregivers. This system pulls data directly from AxisCare; therefore, this role does not involve managing or troubleshooting the TapCheck platform.

• Flexibility: We support a results-oriented work environment. You are welcome to manage other professional commitments, provided that all financial deadlines are met without exception and your performance remains at a high standard.



Work Schedule:



• Schedule: Full-Time.

• Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Pacific Standard Time (PST).

• Break: Includes a 30-minute break within the shift.



Compensation:



• $5 USD per hour.



How to Apply:

Please email your Resume/CV to: 

Subject Line: "Finance & Billing Specialist - [Your Full Name]"



In your email, please include:



1. Your experience generating and managing invoices.

2. Tell me which 3 keyboard shortcuts you use most often in QuickBooks or Excel (to show your technical proficiency).

3. Tell me about a time you had to handle a client billing concern via email. How did you ensure you both understood the goal?

4. Your typical availability during Pacific Standard Time (PST).

Young Publisher –

That includes a multifamily and commercial brokerage, a real estate investment and development firm, a land acquisition company, a multifamily and HOA roofing company, a hospitality group managing restaurants and event venues, and an AI-driven deal sourcing platform.

What you'll do

 - Graphic design: Design one-pagers, flyers, property marketing sheets, offering memorandum layouts, social graphics, pitch decks, and event promos in Canva (Adobe a plus), following each company's brand guidelines.

Required skills

 - Proven experience building Zapier automations (multi-step Zaps, filters, formatters, webhooks)

s, posts, and client materials in my voice for investors, partners, and clients, so grammar and tone must be polished and natural

Nice to have

 / Traction Tools

title: Real Estate Cold Caller + Data Manager VA (REsimpli / Motivated Seller Leads)
description:
Steadfast Home Buyers buys houses directly from homeowners in West Tennessee, USA. We are building a First-to-Market system to reach motivated sellers before our competitors do. We want one dependable, long-term VA to run it.



HOURS

About 49 paid hours per week. Monday to Friday 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM US Central with a 1-hour unpaid lunch, plus Saturday 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM US Central.

In Philippine time: 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM weekdays and 10:00 PM to 2:00 AM Saturday night (mid-March to early November); 11:00 PM to 9:00 AM weekdays and 11:00 PM to 3:00 AM Saturday night (November to mid-March).



PAY

USD 1,050 to 1,700 per month (about USD 5 to 8 per hour), independent contractor, long-term.



THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF

- You have done outbound calling to American homeowners, ideally for real estate investors or wholesalers

- You are as careful with spreadsheets and CRM records as you are confident on the phone

- You like clear targets, daily reporting and honest feedback

- You want a long-term role with one company, not a short gig



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY

1. Data: import, clean and deduplicate owner records in our DataChef workflow (we train you), prioritize fresh records, flag bad contact info, keep list statuses current

2. Calling: call owners on pre-foreclosure, probate, tax delinquent, vacant and code-violation lists using approved scripts; find motivation, condition and timeline; hand qualified sellers to our acquisitions team

3. CRM: log every call in REsimpli, set follow-up tasks, keep stages clean, no duplicates

4. Follow-up: keep in touch with "not right now" owners on schedule; texts only through approved workflows

5. Report: send a daily report of records worked, dials, conversations, qualified leads, follow-ups and handoffs

6. Foreclosure support: organize new foreclosure records, track auction dates, keep outreach history accurate



REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Outbound calling or appointment-setting experience

- Experience with any CRM plus Google Sheets or Excel

- Strong attention to detail

- Can follow written SOPs and work independently

- Desktop or laptop that runs a CRM, dialer and browser smoothly

- USB noise-canceling headset

- Fast main internet plus a backup connection

- Power backup (UPS, generator or an outage plan)

- Quiet, private workspace

- Available for the full US Central shift above



BIG PLUSES

- REsimpli experience

- DataChef, dialer or skip-tracing experience

- Real estate wholesaling or motivated-seller calling

- Experience with foreclosure, probate or distressed-property lists

No DataChef experience is fine if you learn software quickly.



OUR STANDARDS

This is an accountable role with daily numbers and a daily report. All calls and texts follow US telemarketing, do-not-call, consent and opt-out rules, and you never call or text outside approved lists.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply here on OnlineJobs.ph. Start your application with the word FIRSTMOVER so we know you read this whole post. Then include:

1. A link to a 60 to 90 second voice recording: your name, your outbound calling experience, your best calling result, then read this opener: "Hi, is this Mr. Davis? This is [your first name] with Steadfast Home Buyers. I'm calling about the property on Maple Street. Would you ever consider an offer on it?"

2. A link to a 1 to 2 minute video answering: What CRM and spreadsheet work have you done? How do you keep data accurate when busy? Why would you succeed in a role measured on daily numbers?

3. A recent internet speed test result

4. Your computer, headset, internet backup and power backup

5. Your expected monthly rate in USD

Applications without the keyword and both recordings will not be reviewed. Please do not send ID or bank details.

title: PART-TIME SENIOR MARKETING LEAD
description:
PART-TIME SENIOR MARKETING LEAD

Remote, with overlap during U.S. Eastern Time

Part-time, 10–15 hours per week

$20–$25 per hour



THE ROLE

The Neuroplasticity Alliance (NPA) is a small non-profit organization that helps people navigating neurologic challenges build agency, strengthen self-advocacy, and explore recovery resources. We are seeking an experienced marketing leader to own the strategy that turns this mission into sustained audience growth, stronger engagement, and measurable action across digital channels.

This is a hands-on leadership role for a senior marketer who can set direction, make sound editorial and channel decisions, and guide execution through a small production team. The right candidate has built audiences before, understands how to connect content to conversion, and can bring disciplined, credible marketing to a healthcare or mission-driven organization.



WHAT YOU OWN

• Set and manage an annual integrated marketing strategy and editorial calendar, organized around one or two health conditions or audience needs each month.

• Translate the monthly strategy into coordinated social content, lead magnets, blogs,
 campaigns, and newsletters.

• Lead NPA’s social program, including channel planning,
 page oversight, community-response standards, and 10–12 posts per week across platforms.

• Own audience and conversion growth; with leadership set monthly and annual goals for increasing website traffic, followers, and engagement. 

• Direct a weekly blog and subscriber
, a monthly newsletter, and one monthly lead magnet tied to the editorial theme.

• Promote NPA patient and caregiver trainings, navigation sessions, book club, and other events across channels.

• Manage and develop a contractor responsible for preparing, scheduling, and publishing content under your direction.

• Establish reporting that shows what is working, why it is working, and what should change next; present concise recommendations to leadership.

• Maintain brand, editorial, and healthcare-claims standards. Cite underlying research, identify emerging evidence appropriately, and avoid diagnosis, treatment recommendations, cure language, or outcome guarantees.

• Advise leadership on web content, campaign opportunities, and occasional print materials such as brochures and event displays.



HOW WE KNOW IT'S WORKING

• Attain desired monthly increases in website traffic and social media followers, engagement, supported by clear channel and campaign attribution.

• Lead magnets generate qualified visits to directory, program, and event pages.

• Content is delivered consistently, accurately, and on schedule across channels.

• Community questions are answered or routed promptly, and sensitive medical or crisis-related messages follow defined escalation practices.

Follower counts provide context; the most important measure is whether people reach NPA’s website and take a meaningful next step.



WHAT WE NEED

• 10+ years of progressive marketing experience, including senior ownership of integrated digital strategy, audience growth, and campaign performance.

• A documented record of growing website traffic, social audiences, or
 lists; applicants should be prepared to share relevant before-and-after results.

• Strong strategic judgment paired with hands-on execution. You can set the plan, prioritize limited resources, and keep work moving without waiting for detailed direction.

• Experience in healthcare, public health, patient education, or another regulated or evidence-sensitive field strongly preferred; nonprofit healthcare experience is especially valuable.

• Excellent editorial instincts and the ability to maintain a credible, compassionate brand voice across varied audiences.

• Experience managing a contractor, coordinator, or virtual assistant and creating clear workflows, standards, and accountability.

• Working knowledge of analytics,
 marketing, social platforms, content management systems, and practical AI-enabled marketing tools.

• Sound judgment around healthcare claims, research interpretation, privacy, crisis escalation, and the distinction between education and medical advice.



THE WORK, IN PRACTICE

This is a part-time, remote role averaging 10–15 hours per week, with compensation of $20–$25 per hour. Some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time is required for planning calls, community review, and team handoffs. You will partner with leadership on priorities and clinical accuracy while directing a small production pod. You are accountable for the strategy, standards, and results; you are not expected to personally design the assets or publish post.

To apply, send a resume, a brief note describing why this opportunity is a strong fit, and one example of work that produced measurable audience or traffic growth. Include the relevant results and your specific role in achieving them. Submit application materials to 
 with “Senior Marketing Lead” in the subject line

title: Senior Sign Designer – Full-Time Remote Position
description:
Company: Vintage Sign & Light – Florida, USA

Location: Remote – Philippines

Employment Type: Full-Time, 40 Hours Per Week

Schedule: Monday–Friday, with availability to collaborate during U.S. Central Time business hours

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience and technical capabilities



About Our Company

Vintage Sign & Light is a custom commercial sign company located in Valparaiso, FL USA specialize in designing, fabricating, and installing a wide variety of interior and exterior commercial signage.



We are looking for a highly skilled, experienced Senior Sign Designer / Signage Production Designer to join our team as a full-time remote employee.



This is not a general graphic design position. We need a professional who has extensive experience working in the commercial signage industry and understands how signs are designed, manufactured, and installed.

The ideal candidate will have advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, SAi Flexi, vector artwork, technical shop drawings, and production-ready design files.



You will work directly with our U.S.-based team to develop accurate designs and drawings that can move efficiently from customer approval through fabrication and installation.



Signage Experience Required

Candidates should have experience designing a variety of commercial signage, including:

• Illuminated and non-illuminated channel letters

• Monument signs and pylon signs

• Illuminated cabinet signs

• Dimensional letters and logos

• Building and storefront signage

• LED and internally illuminated signs

• Post and panel signage

• Interior and exterior directional signage

• ADA and wayfinding signage

• Vehicle graphics, decals, and wraps

• Wall murals and large-format printed graphics

• Window graphics and perforated vinyl

• Routed and fabricated signage

• Electronic message centers and digital displays

Experience with illuminated signage, channel letters, monument signs, and technical fabrication drawings is particularly important.



Key Responsibilities

Customer Designs and Presentations

• Create professional sign concepts, layouts, and customer proofs.

• Develop realistic sign mockups using building photographs and site measurements.

• Prepare accurate, scaled drawings showing sign dimensions, placement, and specifications.

• Revise designs based on customer and internal team feedback.



Shop Drawings and Technical Documentation

• Create detailed, dimensioned shop drawings for sign fabrication and installation.

• Include materials, construction details, mounting methods, and relevant specifications.

• Prepare drawings and supporting information for sign permit application packages.

• Understand basic fabrication and installation requirements for illuminated and non-illuminated signage.

• Identify potential fabrication or installation challenges before production begins.



Production-Ready Artwork

• Prepare accurate vector files for printing, vinyl cutting, CNC routing, and fabrication.

• Work extensively with Adobe Illustrator and SAi Flexi.

• Ensure correct dimensions, scale, colors, fonts, and file formats.

• Prepare organized production files, including AI, EPS, PDF, SVG, and DXF formats as required.

• Verify artwork accuracy to help prevent production errors and costly remakes.



Team Collaboration

• Work closely with our sales, project management, production, and installation teams.

• Manage multiple projects while meeting established deadlines.

• Communicate proactively regarding project questions, missing information, or design concerns.

• Maintain organized project files and revisions.

• Participate in virtual meetings and collaborate with our U.S.-based team.



Required Qualifications

• Minimum 5 years of professional commercial sign design experience preferred.

• Advanced Adobe Illustrator experience – Required.

• SAi Flexi / FlexiSIGN experience – Required.

• Extensive experience working with vector artwork and production files.

• Proven ability to create accurate, dimensioned shop drawings.

• Experience designing illuminated signs, channel letters, and fabricated commercial signage.

• Strong understanding of sign materials, fabrication techniques, and installation methods.

• Experience preparing print-ready, cut-ready, and fabrication-ready files.

• Ability to interpret measurements, scales, site surveys, and project specifications.

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

• Ability to work independently and consistently meet deadlines.

• Reliable computer, high-speed internet, and a professional remote working environment.



Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience working with U.S.-based commercial sign companies.

• Experience with Adobe Illustrator and SAi Flexi.

• Familiarity with electrical signage and illuminated sign construction.

• Knowledge of aluminum fabrication, acrylic, vinyl, LED lighting, and mounting methods.

• Experience with CNC routing and large-format printing.

• Familiarity with U.S. sign permitting requirements and technical drawing standards.

• Experience collaborating remotely with production and installation teams.



What Makes a Successful Candidate?

We are looking for more than someone who can create attractive graphics.

Our designer must understand how to turn a design into a sign that can actually be manufactured and installed.



The successful candidate will:

• Produce accurate designs and drawings with minimal errors.

• Understand fabrication and installation considerations.

• Recognize potential design problems before they reach production.

• Work efficiently without sacrificing quality.

• Communicate clearly and ask questions when specifications are incomplete.

• Take ownership of assigned projects and meet deadlines.

• Help reduce production remakes, installation issues, and unnecessary revisions.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a dependable, long-term member of our team.



Application Requirements

To be considered, please submit:

1. Resume: Include your previous commercial sign company experience and years in the industry.

2. Portfolio: Provide examples of actual commercial signage projects you have designed.

3. Technical Shop Drawings: Submit at least three examples of detailed, dimensioned shop drawings you personally created.

4. Production Artwork: Provide examples of vector files or production-ready artwork.

5. Software Experience: Describe your proficiency with Adobe Illustrator and SAi Flexi.

6. Salary Expectations: Provide your expected monthly salary in USD for a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position.

7. Availability: Confirm your ability to work 40 hours weekly and coordinate with a U.S.-based team.

title: Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist
description:
Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist



Full-Time Remote | Flexible Schedule | Philippines



Growth Path: Digital Marketing Manager



We’re not looking for someone to simply complete a list of marketing tasks. We’re looking for someone who wants to OWN digital marketing and grow with us.



Lambert Home Inspections is a fast-growing home inspection company based in Northern Virginia. Along with our residential inspection company, our team operates National Commercial Inspections and Capital Environmental, giving our marketing team the opportunity to build and grow three different brands.



We’re looking for a creative, analytical, tech-savvy Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist in the Philippines who wants to become a long-term part of our team.



This is NOT a typical Virtual Assistant position.



You’ll work directly with our leadership and growth team and eventually take ownership of digital marketing across all three companies.



Our goal is simple:



Hire a great Digital Marketing Specialist → develop them → give them ownership → grow them into our Digital Marketing Manager.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN



PAID DIGITAL MARKETING



You’ll help manage and eventually take ownership of:



Google PPC campaigns

Google Local Services Ads (LSA)

Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising

Retargeting campaigns

Keyword and search-term optimization

Negative keywords

Geographic targeting

Advertising budgets

A/B testing

Conversion tracking

Cost-per-lead and customer-acquisition tracking

We currently work with an outside digital marketing agency. During your first few months, you’ll learn how our existing campaigns are managed, review their reporting and help us build our own internal systems.



The goal is for you to eventually take ownership of our digital advertising in-house.



WEBSITE + GOHIGHLEVEL



You’ll help us move and manage our websites through GoHighLevel (GHL) and continually improve them.



This includes:



Website updates

Creating landing pages

Building city/location pages

Creating service pages

Forms and funnels

CRM integrations

Conversion tracking

Website optimization

Marketing automations



We don’t want websites that just look good.



We want websites that generate leads.



SEO + AEO



You’ll help us dominate search across the markets we serve.



Responsibilities may include:



Local SEO

Keyword research

City and service landing pages

On-page SEO

Internal linking

Technical SEO

Schema

Google Business Profile optimization

Backlink opportunities

Search ranking tracking

AI search / Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)

Optimizing content for Google and AI platforms



SOCIAL MEDIA + CONTENT



Our Growth team will capture real-world content from inspections, events, real estate agents, our team and the field.



Your job is to turn that raw content into something people actually want to watch.



You’ll help create:



Instagram/Facebook Reels

Short-form videos

Social media posts

Hooks and captions

Graphics

Educational content

Before/after content

Team/culture content

YouTube content

Content calendars



We want someone who understands that social media in 2026 shouldn’t feel like a corporate brochure.



We want content that’s modern, authentic, entertaining and educational.



✍️
 + CONTENT MARKETING



You’ll also help create:



Weekly/monthly blogs

Realtor newsletters

Client newsletters


 campaigns

Lead nurture campaigns

Past-client campaigns

Referral campaigns

Seasonal marketing campaigns

Automated follow-up sequences



You’ll be working across three different brands, which means there will always be something new to build, test or improve.



ANALYTICS + KPI TRACKING



This is a major part of the position.



We don’t want to guess whether our marketing works.



We want the numbers to tell us.



You’ll help maintain our marketing dashboards and track:



Leads by source

Bookings by source

Revenue by source

Cost per lead

Cost per booked customer

Customer acquisition cost

Return on ad spend

Advertising conversion rates

Website conversion rates

Organic traffic

SEO rankings

Google Business Profile performance

Social media performance


 performance

Lost leads

Marketing-generated revenue

Cross-company referrals



You’ll help prepare the numbers for a monthly marketing meeting with company leadership where we review what worked, what didn’t and what we’re doing next.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You don’t need to know absolutely everything on Day One.



But you should be someone who loves learning, figuring things out and getting better.



We’re looking for someone who is:



Creative

Analytical

Organized

Tech-savvy

Detail-oriented

Comfortable with numbers

Comfortable using AI

A strong communicator

Self-motivated

Curious

Reliable

Excited about digital marketing

Interested in building a career rather than jumping from client to client



Experience with some combination of the following is strongly preferred:



Google Ads • Meta Ads • SEO • GoHighLevel • GA4 • Google Search Console • Google Tag Manager • WordPress/Web Design • Canva • Video Editing • Social Media • Email Marketing • CRM Automations • AI Marketing Tools



YOU’LL PROBABLY LOVE THIS JOB IF…



You watch marketing videos because you actually enjoy them.



You see a bad website and immediately start thinking about how you’d improve it.



You want to know why one advertisement generated 50 leads while another generated five.



You like experimenting with AI and new marketing technology.



You’d rather be given a goal than have someone tell you exactly what button to click every five minutes.



And you want the opportunity to eventually say:



“I run digital marketing for three growing U.S. companies.”



WHERE THIS POSITION CAN GO



We’re hiring a Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist, but we don’t want you to stay a Specialist forever.



As our companies grow and you demonstrate that you can manage our marketing successfully, our goal is to develop this position into:



DIGITAL MARKETING MANAGER



You could eventually oversee digital marketing strategy across:



- Lambert Home Inspections

- National Commercial Inspections

- Capital Environmental



As the companies continue growing, this could eventually mean helping build and manage a larger internal marketing team.



We want someone who grows as we grow.



THE POSITION



Location: Philippines – Remote



Schedule: Full-Time – 40 Hours Per Week. Flexible Scheduling and Workweek



Compensation: $7–$10 USD/hour depending on experience and demonstrated skills



This is intended to be a long-term position dedicated to our companies, not a temporary freelance project.



OUR HIRING PROCESS



We’re less interested in how impressive your résumé sounds and more interested in what you can actually do.



STEP 1 — APPLICATION



Send us:



Your résumé

A short introduction

Your digital marketing experience

Examples of campaigns you’ve managed

Websites/landing pages you’ve created

SEO results

Social/video examples

GHL experience

Any marketing dashboards or reporting you’ve created

Don’t have examples of everything?



That’s okay.



Show us what you’re great at.



STEP 2 — SHORT VIDEO



Selected applicants will submit a short video introducing themselves and answering a few questions.



We want to meet the person behind the résumé.



Tell us what you’re good at, what you’re currently learning and where you want your career to be three years from now.



STEP 3 — INTERVIEW



Top applicants will meet with our team by video.



This isn’t meant to be an interrogation.



We want to learn how you think, how you communicate and whether you’ll fit with our team.



STEP 4 — PAID MARKETING CHALLENGE



Finalists may complete a short paid skills challenge involving real-world marketing situations similar to what you’ll encounter here.



Examples could include:



Reviewing a sample Google Ads campaign

Evaluating a website page for SEO

Creating a landing-page concept

Analyzing marketing KPIs

Turning raw video into a social Reel

Creating a marketing campaign idea

We’re looking at how you think, not just whether you know every answer.



STEP 5 — FINAL INTERVIEW + OFFER



We’ll discuss the challenge, answer your questions and determine whether we’re a good long-term fit for each other.



If we are…



Welcome to the team. ????



ONE LAST THING…



We move fast.



We try new things.



We use technology.



We aren’t afraid of AI.



We measure results.



We have fun.



And we’re building something much bigger than where we are today.



If you’re looking for a position where you can learn, experiment, take ownership and eventually lead digital marketing across multiple growing companies…



we want to hear from you.

title: Part-Time Inventory & Purchasing VA (Retail POS Data Entry)
description:
We are a 24-hour neighbourhood minimart in Singapore (same time zone as the Philippines, UTC+8). We buy from about 100 FMCG suppliers (drinks, snacks, groceries, beer, vegetables). We need a careful, reliable VA to own our daily stock-in and re-ordering admin. THIS IS A DETAIL JOB. Accuracy matters more than speed. 



DAILY TASKS (about 1.5–2 hours, flexible within agreed hours) 

    1. Stock-in into our POS (main task) 

        • Collect supplier invoices (photos, PDFs, e-invoices) from our shared WhatsApp group and
 inbox. 

        • Enter each invoice into our web-based POS back-office (Edgeworks EQuip, "Stock In" module): supplier, invoice number, invoice date, attach invoice image, then each item's quantity and unit cost. 

        • Calculate correct unit cost: net price excluding 9% GST and excluding beverage container deposits (BCRS); convert cartons to units. 

        • Handle free-of-charge (FOC) lines, shortages, and returns per our SOP. 

        • Never leave supplier or cost fields blank. Flag any price change above 5% vs. the last invoice. 

        • Chase missing invoices from suppliers and staff, politely and persistently. 

    2. Low-stock re-ordering 

        • Review the daily low-stock list from our store staff (Google Sheet/Form). 

        • Match each item to its supplier using our supplier master sheet. 

        • Check minimum order quantities (MOQ). Place orders that meet MOQ; roll over items that don't. 

        • Send standard purchase orders by WhatsApp/email and confirm delivery dates. 

        • Escalate urgent stockouts and out-of-stock replies to the owners. 

    3. Daily report 

        • Send a short end-of-day summary: invoices entered, orders placed, issues needing owner decisions. 



REQUIREMENTS 

    • 1+ year of data entry, inventory, purchasing, or bookkeeping experience (retail/grocery/POS is a big plus). 

    • Strong Google Sheets/Excel skills (SUM, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, filters). 

    • Clear written English for supplier messages. 

    • Stable internet, laptop, and a phone with WhatsApp. 

    • Comfortable with repetitive, careful work and following an SOP exactly. 



NICE TO HAVE 

    • Experience with any POS/inventory system (Edgeworks, Xero inventory, QuickBooks, Odoo, etc.). 

    • Familiarity with GST/VAT on invoices. 



WHAT WE OFFER 

    • Long-term, steady part-time role with clear SOPs and training. 

    • Paid trial week. Raise after 3 months based on accuracy KPIs. 

    • Room to grow into a full-time admin role as we expand. 



HOW TO APPLY 

    • Start your application with the words "STOCK-IN READY" so we know you read this fully. 

    • Tell us which POS or inventory systems you have used. 

    • Answer this: An invoice line shows 6 cartons of 24 cans, net price $14.80 per carton, plus a deposit of $2.40 per carton. What unit cost per can do you enter (excluding deposit)? 

    • Shortlisted applicants will do a paid 15-minute test: enter one real supplier invoice into a sheet.

title: Staffing & Quality Control (QC) Compliance Manager
description:
[URGENT] Staffing & Quality Control (QC) Manager (US Healthcare)

Work Location: Philippines (Remote / Work from Home)

Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM Central Standard Time (Texas, USA)

Philippine Shift Equivalent: 9:30 PM – 6:30 AM PHT (Night Shift / Full-Time 40 Hours)

Base Compensation: $600.00 – $800.00 USD / Month ($150.00 – $200.00 USD Based on experience Paid Weekly via Wise) + Quality & Metric Bonuses

About Our Organization

We are a fast-growing, Texas-based healthcare organization operating a clinical staffing agency alongside an allied health vocational institute. We recruit, credential, and place allied health professionals—including Phlebotomists, Certified Medical Assistants (CMA), EKG Technicians, and Patient Care Technicians (PCT)—into clinical facilities and healthcare settings across the region.

We are seeking a detail-obsessed, highly structured Staffing & Quality Control Manager based in the Philippines to take full ownership of candidate credentialing, facility compliance auditing, and placement logistics.

Mandatory Requirements & Qualifications

Educational Background: Bachelor’s Degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing/Allied Health, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field.

Proven Experience: Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in healthcare staffing, credential auditing, compliance management, or clinical recruitment—preferably supporting US-based healthcare facilities, staffing agencies, or medical registries.

Technical Proficiency Required:

GoHighLevel (GHL) or Healthcare Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS): Pipeline management, document tagging, and automated onboarding workflows.

RingCentral / Softphone Systems: Candidate outreach, screening calls, and SMS log management.

Google Workspace: Advanced proficiency in Sheets, Docs, Drive, and data organization.

Work Setup: Quiet, private home office, noise-canceling headset, primary PC/laptop with high-speed internet (min. 25 Mbps), and a functional backup power/internet setup.

Key Responsibilities & Leadership Scope

Zero-Defect Quality Control (QC) Auditing: Conduct meticulous weekly audits of all healthcare candidate credential files (CPR/BLS, national certifications, state licenses, background checks, drug screens, immunizations, and work history) prior to facility placement.

Compliance & Audit Readiness: Ensure 100% compliance with state regulatory boards, healthcare facility contracts, and Joint Commission standards. Track credential expiration dates and proactively collect renewed documents before candidates go non-compliant.

Staffing Pipeline Management: Oversee the candidate onboarding pipeline from initial application through file approval, background check clearing, and placement hand-off.

Facility & Candidate Logistics: Serve as the primary point of contact for candidate onboarding inquiries via RingCentral and
, maintaining a strict 2-hour Service Level Agreement (SLA).

Process Standardization: Refine digital audit checklists, automate expiration reminders in GoHighLevel, and ensure zero compliance errors across active clinical candidate rosters.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Zero Compliance Defects: Maintain a 100% error-free audit score across all deployed candidate credential files.

Credential Onboarding Speed: Reduce candidate file approval turnaround time while maintaining zero audit defects.

Inquiry Resolution SLA: 100% resolution of candidate compliance inquiries within a strict 2-hour window during Texas CST business hours.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Salary: $600.00 – $800.00 USD / Month ($150.00 – $200.00 USD paid weekly every Friday via Wise direct transfer, commensurate with experience).

Performance Bonuses: Eligibility for quarterly metric-based performance bonuses tied to zero-defect audit scores and placement yield.

Career Progression: Leadership pathway to advance into Director of Healthcare Compliance & Operations as agency operations expand.

How to Apply

Please reply directly to this OnlineJobs.ph posting with the subject line:

Experienced Staffing & QC Manager - [Your Full Name]

Include in your application message:

Resume / CV Link: Direct link to your updated CV (highlighting your degree, healthcare compliance experience, and US staffing background).

Relevant Experience Summary: A brief summary outlining your experience with healthcare credential auditing (e.g., CPR, background checks, license verification), GoHighLevel/ATS tools, and US healthcare regulations.

Setup Confirmation: Confirm you have a Bachelor's degree, a quiet home workspace with backup internet, an active Wise account, and full availability for the Texas CST night shift (8:30 AM – 5:30 PM CST / 9:30 PM – 6:30 AM PHT).

title: BDR, Lead Generation and CRM Operations
description:
BDR (Business Development Representative), Lead Generation and CRM Operations

Smart Business Revolution (SBR) | Remote | Part-time, 15 to 20 hours/week, ongoing, with room to expand | $7 to $12/hour | Stack: Apollo, Pipedrive, Claude, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace



ABOUT US

We're an AI and SEO startup helping companies get found, not just on Google but on AI driven platforms like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews. This emerging field is called GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and it's where search is heading. We work with growth minded businesses that want to stay visible as discovery shifts from blue links to AI answers. Founded by a serial entrepreneur who has built and scaled multiple ventures, the company is small, fast, and built for the new era of AI enabled search.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll own lead generation and CRM operations for one of our core clients, a B2B data and analytics company that sells to insurance carriers, managing general agents (MGAs), reinsurers, and brokers. Their sales motion runs on industry conferences, targeted
 campaigns, and LinkedIn outreach.



This role exists because the prospecting and data work behind those campaigns is detailed, recurring, and important to get right. Before each conference, we narrow attendee lists to qualified targets, enrich contacts, and prepare outreach. After each event, we handle follow-up and cleanup. In between, we run broader
 campaigns and keep the CRM clean. You'll take that work off our plate and run it reliably using our SOPs and AI tools.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. Prospect list building and qualification

- Build prospect lists from conference attendee rosters, industry directories, and Apollo

- Use Claude or similar AI tools to research, classify, and filter companies and contacts in bulk against our ideal customer profile

- Verify AI output and flag anything that looks off



2. Contact enrichment

- Enrich contacts in Apollo and match them to existing CRM records

- Fill gaps using manual research when Apollo coverage is thin



3. CRM operations in Pipedrive

- Deduplicate records, apply labels, and update marketing consent status

- Build filters for campaign sends following our naming conventions

- Cross-check prospect lists against current customers and suppression lists before any send



4. Campaign and outreach support

- Prepare
 campaigns for review (every send goes through a strict approval process, and you'll follow it every time)

- Identify LinkedIn targets and organize connection lists



5. Website QA and reporting

- Check for broken links and confirm tracking is in place before major sends

- Pull simple reports on list sizes, campaign results, and outreach status



6. SOPs

- Follow our documented processes in Notion

- Update SOPs as you learn, so the process gets better every cycle



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- Proven experience in B2B lead generation and list building

- Hands-on experience with Apollo (search, enrichment, bulk matching)

- Experience using Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools to filter and qualify leads at scale, with good judgment about checking the output

- CRM experience, ideally Pipedrive (HubSpot or Salesforce also welcome)

- Strong spreadsheet skills (filtering, lookups, deduplication)

- Extremely detail-oriented. A single wrong filter can send an
 to the wrong list, so accuracy matters more than speed.

- Comfortable following SOPs and asking questions rather than guessing

- Clear written English and reliable communication

- Able to overlap at least a few hours per day with U.S. Pacific time

- Open to working differently. We're an AI-first team and build our workflows around tools like Claude, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and Notion. This one is non-negotiable.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience in insurance or another niche B2B vertical

- LinkedIn Sales Navigator experience

- Familiarity with
 marketing consent rules

- Interest in building AI automations and better workflows



WHY JOIN

You'll work directly with the founder, not through layers of management. You'll own a real piece of the client's growth engine and see the results of your work. The role starts at 15 to 20 hours per week, and there's room to grow into more hours and responsibility for the right person. We move fast, use AI in everything we do, and are always testing new tools, so you'll learn a lot. Our core values are simple: be kind, be generous, and always be learning.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. A 1-minute screen recording (Loom or similar) showing how you'd use Claude or another AI tool to filter a list of 200 conference attendees down to qualified prospects, and roughly how long it would take you

2. A short note on which tools you'd recommend for enriching contacts at small regional insurance companies, where Apollo data is often thin, and why

3. Your experience with Apollo and any CRM you've used

4. Your hourly rate within our range, the hours you're typically available (in Pacific time), and whether you'd be interested in more hours over time

5. A screenshot of your Kolbe A result, if you have one

title: Paraplanner (Australian Financial Planning)
description:
EXPERIENCED FINANCIAL PLANNING PARAPLANNER



Australian Financial Planning Firm | 100% Remote | Full-Time



JOIN A SUPPORTIVE TEAM WHERE ATTITUDE, TEAMWORK AND A WILLINGNESS TO LEARN MATTER.



We are looking for an experienced Financial Planning Paraplanner with at least two years of experience supporting Australian financial advisers to join our growing team.



ABOUT US



Essense Wealth Solutions (EWS) is an Australian financial planning business dedicated to helping clients make informed financial decisions through tailored advice and strategic financial planning. Our paraplanning team plays an important role in supporting advisers to deliver quality, client-focused financial advice.



We value people who take ownership of their work, approach challenges with a positive, can-do attitude and genuinely enjoy working as part of a team.



While technical knowledge is important, we believe skills can be developed through training and experience. What matters most is your willingness to learn, ability to accept feedback and commitment to delivering quality work.



WHY JOIN US?



We offer a supportive, fully remote working environment where your contribution is valued and your professional development is encouraged.



• 100% Remote Work – Work from the comfort of your home.

• 15 Days Annual Leave – Receive 15 days of leave credits per year, accrued progressively throughout the year.

• 13th-Month Pay – In accordance with applicable Philippine employment requirements.

• HMO Allowance – Support towards eligible healthcare coverage.

• Paid Victorian Public Holidays – Enjoy paid public holidays observed in Victoria, Australia.

• Training and Career Development – Opportunities to strengthen your skills, learn new systems and progress professionally.

• Performance Reviews – Regular feedback and recognition of your development and contribution.

• Competitive Salary – Based on experience and capabilities.



ABOUT THE ROLE



You will work closely with financial advisers and the paraplanning team to research, develop and prepare financial advice for Australian clients.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Prepare financial advice documents, including Statements of Advice (SOAs), Records of Advice (ROAs), advice letters and supporting documentation.

• Research financial strategies and products across superannuation, pensions, retirement planning, investments and personal insurance.

• Complete financial modelling, calculations and projections to support advice recommendations.

• Review client information, identify inconsistencies and seek clarification where required.

• Liaise with product providers to obtain information and confirm product requirements.

• Maintain accurate client records and supporting research documentation.

• Use AI tools responsibly to support research, advice preparation and workflow efficiency, while verifying the accuracy of your work.

• Work collaboratively with advisers and team members to meet deadlines and maintain quality standards.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Attitude and teamwork are just as important to us as experience.



We are looking for someone who:



• Has a positive, can-do attitude and is willing to take on challenges.

• Is a genuine team player who supports colleagues and contributes to a respectful working environment.

• Takes ownership of their responsibilities and follows through on commitments.

• Is open to feedback, willing to learn and comfortable asking questions.

• Demonstrates initiative, good judgement and attention to detail.

• Communicates clearly and professionally.

• Can work independently, manage priorities and meet deadlines.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS



• At least two years of experience as an outsourced paraplanner supporting Australian financial advisers.

• Experience preparing financial advice documents and conducting financial strategy or product research.

• Working knowledge of the Australian financial planning environment.

• Experience using financial planning software such as Xplan, AdviserLogic, Intelliflo or similar.

• Good Microsoft Word and Excel skills.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.



Qualifications in Financial Planning, experience across different advice strategies and familiarity with AI tools are advantageous but not essential.



We are happy to provide training to the right person who demonstrates the right attitude, commitment and potential.



WORK ARRANGEMENTS



Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Philippines – 100% Remote

Workdays: Monday to Friday

Work Schedule: 6:00 AM–3:00 PM or 7:00 AM–4:00 PM Philippine Time

Working Hours: 40 working hours per week

Salary: Competitive, based on experience and capabilities



APPLICATION SCREENING QUESTIONS



Please answer the following questions when applying.



1. PARAPLANNING EXPERIENCE



Tell us about your experience supporting Australian financial advisers, including the financial planning software you have used and the types of advice documents and strategies you have worked on.



2. INITIATIVE AND PROBLEM-SOLVING



If you were assigned a task that you were unfamiliar with or identified an issue in an advice document, how would you approach the situation?



3. TEAMWORK AND ATTITUDE



Tell us about a time you received constructive feedback or helped a colleague overcome a challenge. How did you respond, and what did you learn?



READY TO JOIN OUR TEAM?



If you are an experienced paraplanner with a positive attitude, a willingness to learn and a genuine commitment to teamwork, we would love to hear from you.



Apply now with your CV and responses to the three screening questions.

title: GoHighLevel Specialist / VA — Product Setup & Ongoing Management
description:
ALVULT — Initial Setup & Ongoing Management

Location: Remote  

Engagement: Initial setup project, with the opportunity for ongoing part-time work



About ALVULT



ALVULT is an Australian product brand developing aluminium protection and storage products, starting with protective tubes for fishing rods.



We’re preparing to launch and have opened a Go High Level account. We’re looking for an experienced, practical VA to set up an organised marketing and sales system, then help manage enquiries and customer follow-ups.



About the role



Your priority will be to build and test our Go High Level system so we can capture product interest, follow up potential customers and track enquiries through to sales.



You’ll work directly with the owner to turn product information, images and approved messaging into clear landing pages and reliable workflows. Once the setup is complete, you’ll help manage the system and suggest improvements.



### Initial setup responsibilities



- Configure the Go High Level account, business settings and user access.

- Connect our domain and configure
 sending.

- Build landing pages that explain the product and encourage enquiries.

- Create forms to collect contact details, colour preferences, sizing requirements and product interest.

- Set up a sales pipeline with clear stages and follow-up tasks.

- Organise contacts using relevant fields and tags.

- Build enquiry confirmations, product information
s and follow-up sequences.

- Set up internal notifications so the owner knows when action is required.

- Connect QR codes used at shows and events to the enquiry page.

- Create a simple dashboard to track leads, follow-ups and sales.

- Test forms, links, notifications and workflows before launch.

- Provide clear documentation and a recorded walkthrough of the completed system.



Pre-sale or payment functionality may be added once pricing, delivery dates and order arrangements are confirmed.



Ongoing responsibilities



- Monitor new enquiries and keep contact records up to date.

- Respond to routine questions using approved product information.

- Follow up with interested customers and maintain the sales pipeline.

- Update landing pages, forms and
 campaigns as needed.

- Check automations and resolve issues.

- Provide a short weekly report covering enquiries, follow-ups, sales and outstanding actions.

- Recommend practical improvements to the customer experience and sales process.



Pricing changes, delivery promises, discounts and unusual customer requests must be referred to the owner. Customer-facing pages and campaigns require approval before publication or activation.



Skills and experience



We’re looking for someone who has:



- Demonstrated experience building and managing Go High Level accounts.

- Strong skills in landing pages, forms, pipelines and workflow automation.

- Experience setting up domains and
 sending.

- Clear written English and a professional, approachable communication style.

- Good attention to detail and a thorough approach to testing.

- The ability to work independently, communicate progress and meet agreed deadlines.

- Willingness to document their work and keep all assets within our business account.



Experience with physical product launches, pre-sales and event lead capture would be an advantage.



What success looks like



Every enquiry is captured correctly, receives the right follow-up and has a clear next step. The owner can easily see who is interested, who needs attention and how the launch is progressing.



The system should be straightforward to use and maintain as ALVULT grows.



How to apply

2. Examples of systems you personally built, preferably with a short video walkthrough.

3. Your proposed approach and estimated timeframe for the initial setup.

title: Home Care Scheduler
description:
On-Call Scheduling Coordinator (Remote – Philippines)



Company: Amity Health Group (with support for our affiliated offices)

Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Pay: $200 USD per week (independent contractor)

Coverage: On call 24/7, Arizona time (MST). Arizona is 15 hours behind Philippine time, so most calls will come in during your overnight and early-morning hours.

Required team meeting: Every Monday at 11:00 a.m. Arizona time (2:00 a.m. Tuesday PHT)



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a dependable On-Call Scheduling Coordinator to support Amity Health Group's home care clients and caregivers in Arizona. You will be the first point of contact whenever a scheduling call or message comes in, at any hour, on any day. You will handle caregiver callouts, open shifts, schedule changes, and urgent communication so clients always know what is happening, who is helping them, and when they will hear from us next.



Call volume is usually light. During slow periods, you will help with scheduling work for our other offices, such as confirming shifts, updating schedules, and following up with caregivers.



RESPONSIBILITIES



On-Call Coverage

- Monitor scheduling calls and messages 24/7 and respond promptly.

- Handle caregiver callouts, late arrivals, cancellations, and client requests.

- Find replacement caregivers when a shift is at risk, and keep working on it until it is covered or escalated.

- Tell affected clients about schedule changes promptly. If coverage is still being arranged, give them a specific time for the next update.

- Confirm changes with both the client and the caregiver, then update the scheduling system.

- Document what happened, why the shift changed, who was contacted, and the outcome.

- Escalate urgent care gaps, safety concerns, and complaints according to company procedures.



Scheduling Support (During Slow Periods)

- Help the scheduling teams at our other offices with assigned tasks, including shift confirmations, schedule updates, and caregiver follow-up.

- Follow each office's procedures and time zone, and keep notes accurate.



Team Communication

- Send a brief summary of open shifts, unresolved issues, and needed follow-up.

- Attend the weekly team call every Monday.



AVAILABILITY AND COMMUNICATION



You must be reachable 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Keep your phone and work communications on and accessible at all times, respond to urgent calls within 15 minutes, and arrange an approved backup if an emergency keeps you from covering.



Missed team calls, long periods without a response, or failure to communicate schedule changes will be documented and handled through performance review. Continued problems may affect future assignments or continued engagement. Pay for work performed will be handled according to the applicable agreement and law.



QUALIFICATIONS



- Scheduling experience in home care, healthcare, or other time-sensitive services preferred.

- Strong English communication skills and calm problem-solving.

- Able to manage several urgent issues at once while keeping accurate notes.

- Comfortable working U.S. hours and responding overnight Philippine time.

- Reliable internet, phone, and computer.

- Backup power or internet (mobile data or UPS) so you can stay reachable during outages.

- Willing to be on call around the clock, including nights, weekends, and holidays.



HOW TO APPLY



Tell us about your scheduling experience and how you would handle a caregiver calling out at 2:00 a.m. Arizona time before a 6:00 a.m. shift.

description:
About us

ComForCare is a home care agency that provides in-home care to seniors across several counties in New Jersey. At its core, our business is recruiting great caregivers and matching them with the clients who need them. We have a culture that values teamwork, learning and professional growth.

About the role

You will keep our caregivers hired and scheduled. You will recruit and onboard new caregivers, and fill and manage shifts so every client is covered.

This role suits someone who stays calm when a caregiver calls off at the last minute, and who follows up with every applicant, every time.

What you will do

Scheduling (daily)

• Match caregivers to client shifts based on skills, location and availability.

• Keep every client’s schedule fully covered: handle call-offs, last-minute changes and shift swaps.

• Answer calls and texts from caregivers, clients and families about schedules, with patience and professionalism.

Recruiting and onboarding (daily and weekly)

• Post and refresh caregiver job ads each week on Indeed and other job sites.

• Contact applicants by phone, text and
, screen them, and schedule interviews.

• Follow up with missed and inactive applicants.

• Walk new hires through applications, background checks and hiring paperwork.

How we measure success

• Every client shift covered, with call-offs filled quickly.

• New caregivers hired and fully onboarded each month, against a monthly goal.

• Caregiver files complete and current.

title: YouTube Production & Upload VA – Faceless Documentary Channel
description:
YouTube Production & Upload VA – Faceless Documentary Channel (Paid Per Video, VidRush Preferred)



We run an established faceless documentary channel on YouTube: long-form videos (30–60 min) about industrial history, cars, engines and famous brands, made with an AI voice. Scripts, research, titles and thumbnail concepts are all done in-house.



We need a reliable VA to turn each finished script into a published video by following a fixed, documented process. This is an execution role: no strategy and no creative guesswork, just precise, on-time work, every day.



WHAT YOU'LL DO (per video, following our SOP and a Trello card)

- Generate the video in VidRush from the finished script using our fixed settings

- Check the render for obvious errors and re-render when needed

- Insert the promo clip and any provided third-party clips in CapCut

- Upload to YouTube Studio: title, description template, tags, playlists, end screen, scheduling

- Upload 2–4 thumbnail versions for YouTube's A/B test (Test & Compare)

- Occasional simple Canva edits (swap text or images on an existing design)

- Post community posts and the comment replies we provide; hide spam

- Move the Trello card and report when done



VOLUME

- 1 video per day (~30 per month)

- Each video takes roughly 45–60 minutes once you know the process



REQUIREMENTS

- Hands-on experience with YouTube Studio (uploading, scheduling, end screens, playlists)

- Experience with AI video tools. VIDRUSH EXPERIENCE IS A STRONG PLUS, so please mention it

- Basic CapCut and Canva skills

- Good written English

- Extremely reliable: daily deadlines, and no missed uploads

- Follows written instructions exactly and asks when something is unclear

- Stable internet and a computer that handles long video files

- Reachable on Discord during your working hours



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with faceless or documentary-style channels

- Experience with YouTube's thumbnail A/B testing (Test & Compare)

- Experience working from Trello



PAY

- $10–12 USD per published video, depending on experience

- Plus $75 USD per month base

- At the current daily pace that's about $375–435 per month



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with "DOCUMENTARY – [Your Name]". Applications without this won't be reviewed.



Include:

1. Links to YouTube channels you've uploaded for or managed, and what exactly you did

2. Which AI video tools you've used. Have you used VidRush? If yes, for how long?

3. Your weekly availability and your time zone hours

4. A short Loom video (max 2 minutes) introducing yourself in English



Shortlisted candidates do a PAID TEST: one video end to end, uploaded as unlisted. The start date is the end of October.

title: Principal Mechanical Engineer / Engineering Lead — Medical Devices (US Client, Long-Term)
description:
JOB TITLE: Principal Mechanical Engineer / Engineering Lead — Medical Devices (US Client, Long-Term)

Job Type: Contract / Project-based, Full-time hours

Work Setup: 100% Home-based / Remote

Pay: Competitive Compensation; Commensurate with experience

Work Hours: US Mountain Time business hours (required — you'll be working the same schedule as the US team, not night shift)



About the Client

Our client is a well-established, Colorado-based medical device engineering company. They help their clients design and build Class II medical devices, everything from early concept, through prototyping and testing, to final design. This is a long-term opportunity with a stable, growing US company that genuinely values senior-level Filipino engineering talent, this isn't a one-off gig.



About the Role

They're looking for an experienced Principal Mechanical Engineer to take the lead on their engineering projects. You'll do real, hands-on engineering work, SolidWorks CAD, FEA simulations, GD&T drawings, while also being the senior technical contact for their US-based clients, and guiding a small team of 1 to 5 engineers depending on what's active. This is a senior, high-responsibility role, and it's fully remote, working US Mountain Time business hours.



What You'll Be Doing



● Lead the technical/mechanical engineering side of Class II medical device projects.

● Do hands-on work yourself: SolidWorks CAD modeling, assembly design, FEA (structural, thermal, fatigue), tolerance analysis, and GD&T drawings (ASME Y14.5).

● Be the main point of contact for clients on technical questions, running design reviews and status updates directly.

● Handle the engineering side of project management, scoping, timelines, tracking progress, and flagging risks early.

● Lead and mentor a small team of 1–5 engineers.

● Take projects from concept to final design, prototyping, testing, and handoff , following proper design controls.

● Build and test prototypes hands-on when needed (3D printing, machining, bench testing).

● Review and approve engineering documents (drawings, specs, test protocols) before they go to the client.



What You Need to Qualify

● At least 10 years of experience in medical device engineering (mechanical engineering focus).

● Direct experience with Class II medical devices, design controls, ISO 14971 risk management, design history files.
