title: Growth, Marketing & Operations VA
description:
Growth, Marketing & Operations VA

Ecolux Senior Living | Full-Time | 8 AM–5 PM California Time



We are looking for an exceptional, proactive Virtual Assistant to join Ecolux Senior Living, a growing senior-living company in the San Francisco Bay Area.



This is NOT a typical administrative VA position.

We are looking for someone who can help us grow occupancy, build referral relationships, execute marketing campaigns, launch new businesses, and coordinate operations when needed.



Approximately 75–80% of this position will focus on growth, marketing, sales support, and new ventures, with approximately 20–25% focused on Ecolux operational coordination and weekend support.



Your #1 Goal

Help us maintain:

100% occupancy + a strong waitlist across all Ecolux locations.



You will help generate leads, develop referral relationships, follow up with prospects, schedule tours, manage our CRM, improve our online presence, and develop systems that consistently generate new residents.



Key Responsibilities

Occupancy & Growth — 75–80%

Generate qualified resident leads

Build relationships with senior placement agencies, hospitals, hospice, home health, rehab facilities, social workers, case managers, and other referral partners

Conduct email, phone, LinkedIn, and online outreach

Follow up aggressively and professionally with leads and referral partners

Manage our CRM and sales pipeline

Schedule and confirm facility tours

Follow leads from inquiry → tour → deposit → move-in

Help maintain a resident waitlist

Generate Google reviews and testimonials

Manage Google Business Profiles

Assist with social media, YouTube, Canva, CapCut, and marketing campaigns

Update our Squarespace websites

Research competitors and new marketing opportunities

Use ChatGPT and other AI tools to automate marketing, research, outreach, and follow-up

New Business Ventures



You will also help us research, organize, market, and launch new Ecolux/BMV initiatives, including:

Ecolux Home Care

Senior placement services

Ecolux technology/AI initiatives

Wellness programs

Events and other new ventures

Additional businesses and projects as we expand



This could include market research, competitor analysis, lead generation, vendor research, project coordination, website/content creation, outreach, and launch support.



Operations Coordination — 20–25%

Initially, this position will also provide operational support for our senior-living homes, particularly on weekends.

This may include:

Monitoring caregiver communication

Checking that important resident-care tasks are completed

Following up on staffing/call-outs

Reviewing operational dashboards

Coordinating caregiver issues

Monitoring medication/documentation exceptions

Tracking facility or maintenance issues

Making sure urgent items are escalated

Helping ensure nothing important falls through the cracks



You will work with our existing operations team rather than independently managing resident care.



Schedule

Full-Time: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM California/Pacific Time



You MUST be comfortable consistently working California business hours.



Some weekend operational coordination will also be required, particularly during the initial phase of the position. The weekly schedule can be structured accordingly so this does not simply mean working seven full days every week.



Who We Want

We are looking for someone who is:

Extremely proactive and resourceful

Excellent in spoken and written English

Comfortable making phone calls

Strong in sales, lead generation, and follow-up

Highly organized

Persistent without being pushy

Comfortable managing multiple projects

Excellent at online research

Tech savvy

Comfortable learning new software quickly

Experienced with AI tools such as ChatGPT

Able to identify problems and solve them without waiting for detailed instructions



Experience with healthcare, senior living, real estate, sales, appointment setting, lead generation, digital marketing, operations, or project management is highly desirable.



Experience with tools such as Airtable, Google Workspace, Canva, CapCut, CRM software, Squarespace, LinkedIn, and ChatGPT is a plus.



What Success Looks Like

You will be measured by outcomes, including:

Ecolux occupancy %

Size and quality of our waitlist

Qualified leads generated

Referral relationships developed

Tours scheduled

Resident move-ins

Follow-up completion

Reviews/testimonials generated

Marketing initiatives executed

Successful launch and progress of new ventures

Operational issues properly followed through

Growth Opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term role and significantly more responsibility over time.



As Ecolux and our other businesses grow, the right person could eventually develop into a Growth Manager / Business Development Manager and help oversee additional team members.



How to Apply

Start your application with the words:

ECOLUX GROWTH

Then answer these questions:



Tell us briefly about your experience with lead generation, sales, marketing, operations, or business development.

Are you available to consistently work 8 AM–5 PM California time?

Are you comfortable making outbound phone calls to businesses and referral partners?

What AI tools do you currently use?

What CRM, Airtable, Canva, CapCut, Squarespace, or marketing tools have you used?

What is your expected monthly salary?

Describe one situation where you were given a goal but very little instruction and figured out how to accomplish it.



Finally, answer this:

If Ecolux had 3 empty rooms that needed to be filled within the next 30 days, what would you do during your first 7 days to generate qualified prospects and move-ins?



We are looking for someone who thinks like an owner and problem solver, not someone who simply waits for tasks.

We need a hands-on SEO professional who understands the bigger picture, knows how to prioritize opportunities, and can connect technical SEO, content, link acquisition, and analytics to measurable results.

YOUR MISSION: TURN SEARCH OPPORTUNITIES INTO GROWTH

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Develop and execute Penji's overall SEO strategy and roadmap.

Identify high-value keyword opportunities through keyword research, competitor analysis, and search-intent analysis.

Monitor technical performance and proactively identify potential problems.

Develop and oversee link-building and digital PR strategies.

Identify opportunities to acquire relevant, high-quality backlinks.

Evaluate backlink profiles and competitor link strategies.

Focus on sustainable authority-building practices that support long-term organic growth.



5. TURN DATA INTO DECISIONS

Use Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Ahrefs, Semrush, and other relevant tools to evaluate performance.

Identify what's working, what's underperforming, and what needs to change.

Prepare clear SEO reports with meaningful insights, priorities, and recommended actions.

Continuously test, measure, and refine strategies based on actual performance.



6. STAY AHEAD OF THE SEARCH LANDSCAPE

Monitor competitors, search trends, and emerging opportunities.

Stay informed about Google algorithm updates and SEO industry developments.

Adapt strategies based on changing search behavior, website performance, and business priorities.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution.



YOUR EXPERIENCE

At least 3 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably managing campaigns in competitive search markets.

A proven track record of improving organic traffic, search rankings, qualified leads, or conversions.

Experience developing and executing SEO strategies—not just following predefined instructions.

Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, content SEO, keyword research, and link acquisition.

A solid understanding of search intent, keyword clustering, topical authority, internal linking, and content optimization.

Practical experience using Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics 4.

Experience collaborating with content teams, writers, developers, or digital marketing professionals.



YOUR APPROACH

Analytical, strategic, and results-oriented.

Capable of turning complex SEO findings into practical action plans.

Proactive in identifying opportunities and solving problems.

Organized, detail-oriented, and accountable for deliverables.

Comfortable working independently and managing priorities.

An excellent English communicator who can explain SEO insights clearly.



IMPORTANT: SHOW US WHAT YOU'VE ACTUALLY DONE

SEO EXPERIENCE IS NOT ENOUGH. WE NEED EVIDENCE OF EXECUTION.



We are not looking for someone who only understands SEO terminology, has completed SEO courses, or knows how to generate reports.



We need someone who can demonstrate real-world SEO experience, explain the strategies they implemented, and show how their work contributed to measurable results.

But can you identify the right publishers, create outreach that gets real responses, build lasting relationships, and secure backlinks that actually contribute to SEO growth?

That's the difference between a backlink collector and a strategic link builder.



At Penji, we're looking for an experienced Off-Page SEO & Link Building Specialist who knows how to turn research, relationships, and smart outreach into valuable backlink opportunities.

We don't measure success by how many
s you send or how many links you collect.

We care about the quality of the websites you target, the relevance of the links you earn, and the value your work brings to our organic search performance.

If you know how to build links that matter, we want to see what you've accomplished.



YOUR MISSION: EARN LINKS THAT MAKE A DIFFERENCE

Your goal isn't to build thousands of backlinks.

Your goal is to earn the RIGHT links from the RIGHT websites for the RIGHT reasons.

You'll help strengthen Penji's backlink profile, improve our off-page SEO, and uncover opportunities to build authority across relevant industries, including:

• SaaS and technology

• Graphic design and creative services

• Startups and entrepreneurship

• Marketing and digital marketing

• Business and productivity



We're looking for relevant, credible websites with genuine audiences, strong editorial standards, and content that makes sense for our brand.

Quality over quantity. Strategy over spam. Relationships over transactions.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

1. FIND BACKLINK OPPORTUNITIES WORTH PURSUING

Research, qualify, and prioritize websites that can provide meaningful SEO value.

You'll evaluate opportunities based on:

• Topical and contextual relevance

• Genuine organic search traffic

• Topical authority and website credibility

• Editorial standards and content quality

• Link placement and surrounding content

• Anchor text and destination URL

• Link attributes, including follow and sponsored attributes

• Overall SEO value and acquisition effort

We don't want someone who judges a website by Domain Rating alone. We want someone who understands the bigger picture.



2. TURN OUTREACH INTO REAL RELATIONSHIPS

Develop and execute personalized outreach campaigns that attract attention for the right reasons.

You'll:

• Research relevant publishers, editors, bloggers, website owners, and journalists.

• Write personalized pitches that explain the value of the proposed collaboration.

• Build genuine relationships with potential publishing partners.

• Follow up professionally and manage outreach conversations.

• Secure relevant editorial placements and other appropriate link opportunities.

• Maintain an organized pipeline and track outreach performance.

No generic copy-paste blasts. No spam. No sending
s just to hit a quota.

We want outreach that gives publishers a legitimate reason to respond.



3. PROMOTE CONTENT THAT DESERVES TO BE LINKED

Work with our Creative and Marketing teams to identify content and assets worth promoting, including:

• Original research and data-driven content

• Infographics and visual assets

• Industry guides and useful resources

• Guest articles and expert contributions

• Creative campaigns that attract relevant attention

Your job is to understand who would benefit from our content, why they would reference it, and how to reach them with a compelling pitch.



4. OUTSMART THE COMPETITION WITH BACKLINK RESEARCH

Use SEO tools and competitive analysis to discover opportunities others may overlook.

You'll:

• Analyze competitor backlink profiles.

• Identify referring-domain gaps and link opportunities.

• Research relevant publishers and industry websites.

• Evaluate competitors' link acquisition strategies.

• Identify pages and assets attracting valuable backlinks.

• Develop practical strategies to strengthen Penji's backlink profile.

We expect you to turn research into an actionable acquisition plan—not simply export spreadsheets and call it a day.



5. TRACK PERFORMANCE AND IMPROVE RESULTS

Monitor your campaigns, evaluate what works, and use the data to improve future outreach.

You'll track relevant metrics such as qualified prospects, outreach response rates, positive replies, placements secured, referring domains acquired, and the quality of acquired links.

Where appropriate, you'll also help assess changes in organic visibility and rankings while recognizing that SEO outcomes depend on multiple factors.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Proven hands-on experience in off-page SEO, link building, or digital PR.

• Demonstrated experience acquiring relevant, high-quality backlinks.

• Experience securing backlinks from websites with DR 50+ is highly preferred, provided the websites also meet quality and relevance standards.

• Strong understanding of white-hat SEO and sustainable link acquisition.

• Knowledge of Google's link spam policies and link quality principles.

• Excellent written English and professional outreach communication skills.

• Strong prospecting, research, and competitor-analysis abilities.

• Experience communicating with publishers, editors, bloggers, journalists, or website owners.

• Strong organization, follow-through, and time-management skills.

• A proactive, resourceful, and results-oriented approach.



TOOLS YOU SHOULD KNOW

Experience with the following platforms is a strong advantage:

• Ahrefs

• Semrush

• Hunter

• BuzzStream

• Pitchbox

• Other SEO research, prospecting, CRM, and outreach platforms



KNOWING THE TOOLS IS NOT ENOUGH.

We want someone who knows how to interpret the data, identify worthwhile opportunities, personalize outreach, and turn those opportunities into real placements.



BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE EXPERIENCE IN:

• SaaS, technology, startup, or design-related industries

• Digital PR and journalist outreach

• Guest posting and editorial contributions

• Resource-page link building

• Niche edits and contextual link placements

• Competitor backlink gap analysis

• Topical authority and entity-based SEO

• Creative campaigns that attract natural backlinks

• Building publisher relationships from scratch



THIS IS NOT A MASS-OUTREACH JOB

If your entire strategy is to send 10,000
s and hope a few people respond, this probably isn't the right role for you.

We need someone who can:



FIND BETTER OPPORTUNITIES.

Identify websites that are genuinely relevant to Penji and worth approaching.



WRITE BETTER OUTREACH.

Create personalized pitches that communicate value rather than demand a backlink.



BUILD STRONGER RELATIONSHIPS.

Develop professional connections that create opportunities beyond a single placement.



EARN BETTER LINKS.

Prioritize editorial relevance, credibility, context, and long-term value.



DELIVER MEASURABLE RESULTS.

Track acquisition performance, learn from the data, and continually improve the strategy.

We value sustainable link acquisition—not inflated numbers, manipulative tactics, or vanity metrics.



YOUR LINK-BUILDING PORTFOLIO IS YOUR PROOF

Don't just tell us you're good at link building. SHOW US THE LINKS YOU'VE ACTUALLY EARNED.

Your application should include real backlink examples from projects you completed or actively managed.

For each example, provide as much of the following information as possible:

• Target URL: The page that received the backlink.

• Source URL: The webpage containing the backlink.

• Domain Rating (DR): The source domain's DR, preferably supported by an Ahrefs screenshot or report.

• Link Type: Editorial link, guest post, resource link, niche edit, or another relevant category.

• Anchor Text: The text used for the backlink.

• Link Attribute: Follow, nofollow, sponsored, or other applicable attribute.

• Placement Type: Paid or unpaid.

• Your Contribution: Explain how you identified the opportunity and secured the placement.



Please distinguish links you personally acquired from links obtained by other team members. If client confidentiality applies, redact sensitive details while providing enough evidence to validate your work.

Actual backlink examples are strongly preferred over generic SEO portfolios.



CASE STUDIES ARE HIGHLY ENCOURAGED

If your work has contributed to improvements in organic rankings, referring domains, organic traffic, or overall SEO performance, show us the evidence.

Tell us:

1. What was the original challenge?

2. What link-building strategy did you implement?

3. How did you identify and qualify your prospects?

4. What types of links did you acquire?

5. What measurable results did you observe?

6. What did you learn, and what would you improve?

We're interested in your actual process, decision-making, and contribution—not just impressive-looking metrics.



IMPORTANT: Applications without relevant hands-on link-building experience or supporting work samples may not be considered.



WHY JOIN PENJI?

At Penji, you'll have the opportunity to:

• Work 100% remotely.

• Collaborate with our Creative and Marketing teams.

• Contribute to off-page SEO and digital PR initiatives.

• Develop your expertise in strategic link acquisition and authority building.

• Work with a team that values quality, communication, and accountability.

• Build your career in a collaborative, results-driven remote environment.



We want people who take ownership of their work, communicate professionally, and continually look for better ways to deliver results.



READY TO BUILD LINKS THAT MATTER?

If you know how to combine research, strategic outreach, publisher relationships, and quality placements to strengthen a website's authority, we'd like to hear from you.



HOW TO APPLY

STEP 1 — COMPLETE THE OFFICIAL PENJI APPLICATION FORM

Application Form:



STEP 2 — SUBMIT YOUR LINK-BUILDING PORTFOLIO

Include actual backlink examples and, preferably, a case study demonstrating your strategy and results.

Show us the links you've earned, the opportunities you've identified, and the outreach methods you've used.

Applications that demonstrate verifiable execution will receive stronger consideration than applications containing only general SEO claims.

 

YOUR NEXT MOVE

DON'T JUST COLLECT BACKLINKS. BUILD AUTHORITY THAT LASTS.

Find better opportunities.

Build stronger relationships.

Earn more valuable links.

Contribute to sustainable SEO growth.



JOIN PENJI. BUILD AUTHORITY. MAKE EVERY LINK COUNT.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. title: Senior Payroll Officer
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.



We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.



And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Payroll Officer to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



-You’ll play an important role in ensuring our people are paid accurately and on time. Your responsibilities will include:

-Processing Australian and Contractor’s payroll accurately and on schedule

-Managing payroll changes, including new starters, salary updates, leave, allowances, and terminations

-Reviewing timesheets and payroll data to ensure accuracy

-Assisting with PAYG, superannuation, leave entitlements, STP, and other payroll requirements

-Reconciling payroll reports and investigating discrepancies

-Responding to employee payroll queries in a timely and professional manner

-Working closely with our Finance and People Operations teams

-Supporting payroll reporting, audits, and process improvements



What We’re Looking For



We’d love to hear from you if you have:

-3+ years experience as a Payroll Officer or similar payroll role

-Experience processing Australian payroll

-A good understanding of PAYG, superannuation, leave entitlements, and Australian payroll requirements

-Strong attention to detail and excellent numerical skills

-Experience using payroll and accounting software

-Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

-The ability to manage deadlines and work independently

-Excellent communication and problem-solving skills

-A high level of professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information

-A qualification or relevant studies in Accounting, Finance, Payroll, or a related field.

-Experience working in a fast-paced or high-growth business.



What’s in it for you?



This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:



-Strong opportunities for career growth and progression

-A high-performing and highly engaged team environment

-Autonomy and flexibility, including work-from-home options

-A competitive remuneration package

-The opportunity to help transform an industry and make a real human impact



The main reason you’ll join, however, is because you believe in what we’re building. You’re excited by growth. You want to help scale a business that is genuinely changing lives — and you want your finance expertise to be part of that journey.



Please include your resume in your application. Thank you!

title: Short-Form UGC Video Editor | CapCut | Reels, TikTok & Ad Variations
description:
Short-Form UGC Video Editor | Long-Term Opportunity | CapCut & TikTok Ads



PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE JOB DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING. GENERIC APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



 ABOUT ME



My name is Logan King. I'm a Canadian content creator building a personal brand and UGC content business.



I'm looking for a reliable, skilled, and detail-oriented video editor based in the Philippines who wants to build a long-term working relationship.



I'm not looking for someone to edit one video and disappear. I'm looking for someone who can eventually become a core part of my content production team as the business grows.



My goal is to focus on scripting, filming, and working with brands while having a reliable editor handle post-production.



 WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



The primary focus will be short-form UGC advertisements for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and other social media platforms.



These videos will typically be 15–60 seconds long.



Content will include:



* Talking-head advertisements for apps, software, and digital services.

* Product demonstrations and testimonials.

* Fitness, lifestyle, and consumer product advertisements.

* Multiple hook variations of the same advertisement.

* Organic-looking UGC designed to feel natural rather than overly produced.



I'm specifically looking for someone who understands modern UGC editing, not traditional corporate video editing.



The goal is to create videos that grab attention immediately, maintain viewer interest, and communicate the product's value naturally.



 Your Responsibilities



You'll be responsible for:



* Editing raw footage into polished, engaging short-form advertisements.

* Removing unnecessary pauses, mistakes, and dead space.

* Adding clean, accurate, well-timed captions.

* Adding appropriate B-roll, screenshots, and screen recordings when provided.

* Using subtle sound effects, transitions, and zooms where appropriate.

* Creating multiple variations of an advertisement by changing hooks, footage sequences, captions, or other specified elements.

* Organizing finished videos and project files in shared folders.

* Following creative briefs and editing references.

* Making reasonable revisions based on feedback.

* Delivering projects on agreed deadlines.



You must understand that good UGC editing isn't about adding as many effects as possible.



Sometimes the best edit is simple, clean, and natural.



Who This Job Is For



This opportunity is ideal for someone who:



✅ Has experience editing TikTok, Instagram Reels, or short-form UGC advertisements.



✅ Understands the importance of the first 1–3 seconds of a video.



✅ Can make talking-head footage engaging without excessive effects.



✅ Is comfortable editing in CapCut or another efficient editing program.



✅ Can create multiple variations from the same original footage.



✅ Has strong attention to detail, especially with captions and audio.



✅ Communicates clearly in English.



✅ Can follow specific instructions without needing constant supervision.



✅ Is reliable with deadlines and communicates proactively.



✅ Is comfortable working on a per-video payment structure.



✅ Wants consistent, long-term work as the business grows.



 Who This Job Is NOT For



Please do not apply if:



❌ You primarily edit long-form YouTube videos and have little short-form experience.



❌ You rely on excessive transitions, flashy effects, or unnecessary animations.



❌ You cannot provide examples of short-form advertisements you've edited.



❌ You regularly miss deadlines without communicating.



❌ You need detailed instructions for every single cut.



❌ You are uncomfortable receiving constructive feedback and making revisions.



❌ You are looking exclusively for a full-time salaried position.



❌ You cannot consistently produce clean, professional work.



❌ You are applying to every job without reading the description.



I'm not expecting perfection. I'm looking for someone who's skilled, dependable, easy to communicate with, and willing to improve alongside the business.



 PAYMENT AND WORK STRUCTURE



Starting budget: $5 USD per original short-form video editing package.



A package may include the primary edit and multiple variations using the same footage, depending on the project brief.



To be completely transparent, this budget is intended for straightforward, repeatable UGC edits. Projects requiring extensive motion graphics, sourcing additional footage, or substantial restructuring will be quoted separately.



Before accepting any project, you'll know exactly what's required, including the number and complexity of variations.



I'm looking to build an efficient production workflow that benefits both of us.



Work will initially be project-based, with the potential for increasing volume and ongoing collaboration as the business grows.



There is no guaranteed minimum volume during the initial testing period.



What I'm Looking for Long-Term



I'm not just looking for somebody who can edit.



I'm looking for somebody I can trust with an important part of my business.



As the business grows, I'd like to establish a consistent workflow where I can record multiple videos, upload the footage, and have my editor handle the production process with minimal back-and-forth.



The right person could eventually take on significantly more projects and become a key member of my production team.



 HOW TO APPLY



IMPORTANT: Applications submitted directly through OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be considered.**



To apply for this position, you must send me a direct message on Instagram 
 



Start your message with "BLUE PINEAPPLE" so I know you've read the entire job description.



I'm looking for one or two excellent editors who want to grow alongside my business, not somebody who's just looking for a quick one-time project.

title: Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (Full or partial US hours overlap required)



About OpenCall 



OpenCall's voice AI handles calls for multi-location medical groups. We're solving a unique challenge: pushing the limits of AI at millisecond performance to have the best human-like customer service experience at enterprise scale. Our AI is faster, cheaper, more powerful, and more reliable than anything else on the market. We let businesses answer the phone and make outbound calls automatically—answering questions, booking appointments, and integrating directly with existing booking software.



We are looking for a Quality Assurance Specialist who can rigorously pressure-test our AI agents and ensure they consistently deliver a flawless, human-like conversational experience for the medical and dental practices we serve. 



About the role



As a Quality Assurance Specialist at OpenCall, you are the final line of defense ensuring our AI voice agents sound natural, respond accurately, and navigate complex conversations flawlessly. This is a highly impactful, non-engineering role focused entirely on conversational quality and product reliability.



You will rigorously test both our inbound and outbound phone agents, actively trying to break them by introducing edge cases, unexpected questions, and complex medical scheduling scenarios. You will ensure our AI can handle the unpredictable nature of real human conversations before deployments go live for our medical and dental practices.



Responsibilities



- Conversational Testing: Conduct extensive manual testing of inbound and outbound AI voice agents over the phone, simulating real-world patient interactions, objections, and edge cases.



- Issue Identification & Reporting: Document bugs, prompt failures, unnatural pauses, and conversational dead-ends. You will translate these conversational breakdowns into clear, actionable reports for our engineering and prompt development teams.



- Call Auditing & Grading: Listen to and review call recordings and transcripts from live and test environments to grade AI performance against our strict quality and safety standards.



- Collaborative Iteration: Work closely with Agent Developers and Customer Success Managers to understand customer-specific workflows (like complex dental scheduling rules) and verify that the AI adheres to those precise constraints.



What we're looking for

- Extensive QA or relevant experience: You have 5+ years of experience in quality assurance, conversational design testing, contact center operations, or a highly rigorous analytical role.



- Exceptional English fluency: Because you are evaluating the nuances of spoken English—including tone, register, phrasing, and regional accents—native-level or highly fluent English speaking and listening skills are an absolute requirement.



- Meticulous attention to detail: You notice the subtle difference between an AI sounding "helpful" versus "robotic," and you possess the focus required to run through dozens of conversational flows without letting small errors slip through the cracks.



- Tech-savvy problem solver: You do not need to be an engineer or write code, but you must be highly comfortable working alongside technical teams, navigating internal dashboards, and utilizing modern software tools to log your findings.



Preferred Qualifications

- Full overlap with US business hours (partial overlap is acceptable for the ideal candidate).

- Prior experience testing voice AI, chatbots, LLMs, or working in conversational AI.

- Familiarity with healthcare operations, medical/dental scheduling workflows, or terminology.

- There is a $50 monthly attendance bonus for consistent on-time performance.

With base hours plus bonuses and performance increases, a strong performer can earn up to around $1,100 per month.



HIRING PROCESS



Shortlisted candidates will complete a quiz that typically takes about one hour.



Candidates who pass the quiz will proceed to two live mock calls or skill assessments:



- The first assessment usually takes around 20 minutes.

- The second assessment is more comprehensive and typically takes about one hour.



After successfully completing the assessments, selected candidates will proceed with orientation and training.



Please note that our assessments are designed to evaluate communication skills, accuracy, speed, attention to detail, and the ability to interact effectively with customers.



Please apply only if you are fully available for a full-time position.



When You Apply*



Please answer the following questions:

2. How soon are you ready to start?



Lastly, please include a link to a Vocaroo audio recording (minimum 45 seconds) where you briefly introduce yourself. Tell us a bit about your background, relevant experience, and one hobby you genuinely enjoy. This is a voice account and you will be supporting customers, so it's essential that you send a high-quality voice recording.



Thanks,

Alfred

title: Logistics Operations Analyst (On Time Performance Admin)
description:
GH Logistics is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on disciplined execution, accurate shipment tracking, and clear communication. As our operation continues to grow, we are looking for On Time Performance (OTP) Admins who can help strengthen our dispute management process, ensure transportation delays are properly documented, and support accurate, timely client dispute filings.



Role Overview

You will support our On Time Performance team by reviewing client transportation disputes, investigating shipment delays, gathering supporting evidence, and ensuring disputes are processed accurately and within their deadlines.



This role combines dispute investigation, documentation review, and shipment tracking verification. Depending on your assigned shift, you will also support either morning handoffs for overnight shipment exceptions or evening tracking checks for upcoming loads. You will work closely with our OTP team during training before gradually taking ownership of assigned dispute reviews and documentation responsibilities.



If you enjoy investigating shipment discrepancies, reviewing GPS tracking records, organizing evidence, and making sure transportation disputes are supported by accurate information, this role is an excellent fit.



What You’ll Be Doing

•  Review and process transportation performance disputes involving late arrivals, departures, missed appointments, and other shipment irregularities.

•  Investigate shipment delays by comparing USPS records against internal transportation systems, GPS tracking data, and supporting documentation.

•  Review shipment timelines, GPS records, appointment details, and operational updates to identify discrepancies.

•  Prepare dispute responses, supporting documentation, and case summaries using established procedures.

•  Prioritize time sensitive cases and ensure assigned reviews are completed within established deadlines.

•  Verify shipment tracking availability, supporting documentation, and recorded reasons for delays.

•  Identify missing tracking information, delay explanations, or shipment documentation and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams.

•  Request and organize additional supporting records when necessary for investigations.

•  Maintain accurate dispute records, documentation checks, and case updates in internal tracking systems.

•  Escalate conflicting information, recurring operational issues, missing documentation, and unresolved cases to the OTP Team Lead.



Shift-Specific Responsibilities



Early Shift – Thursday to Monday, 6 AM - 3 PM Central Time

•  Coordinate with the night shift operations team during morning handoffs to collect updates on overnight shipment delays and exceptions.

•  Verify that priority loads have complete tracking records, delay explanations, and supporting documentation.

•  Identify and communicate missing evidence before continuing with assigned dispute processing.



Late Shift – Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Central Time

•  Process assigned disputes and review daytime shipment documentation.

•  Conduct evening tracking checks to verify FourKites tracking availability for priority loads scheduled to depart.

•  Communicate missing tracking information and documentation gaps to the night shift operations team leads before the end of the shift.



What Success Looks Like

•  Transportation performance disputes are accurately investigated, supported by reliable documentation, and processed within established deadlines.

•  Dispute decisions are consistent, well-documented, and based on verified transportation records.

•  Missing tracking information, delay reasons, and supporting documentation are identified and communicated promptly.

•  Morning handoffs or evening tracking checks are completed accurately based on the assigned shift.

•  Shared dispute and tracking records remain complete, organized, and updated.

•  Issues requiring further investigation are escalated promptly rather than resolved through unsupported assumptions.

•  Assigned responsibilities are handled independently and consistently after training.



Who We’re Looking For

•  Previous experience in U.S. freight brokerage, logistics operations, Track & Trace, transportation monitoring, or dispute investigation is highly preferred.

•  Familiarity with shipment tracking, GPS monitoring, appointment schedules, transportation delays, and delivery documentation.

•  Experience reviewing shipment discrepancies, investigating operational issues, or validating information across multiple records.

•  Comfortable working with transportation management systems, shipment tracking platforms, and operational databases.

•  Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to interpret timestamps, shipment records, and supporting documentation.

•  Proficient in Excel, Google Sheets, and maintaining accurate operational trackers.

•  Clear written and verbal English communication skills.

•  Organized, proactive, and able to manage time-sensitive tasks independently after training.

•  Reliable computer, primary and backup internet connection required; minimum typing speed of 50 WPM.



Why Join GH Logistics?

•  Independent Contractor Setup

•  $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

•  Structured systems and clear expectations

•  Hands on training and direct feedback

•  Defined responsibilities and measurable performance expectations

•  Opportunity to gain specialized experience in U.S. transportation dispute management and performance analysis

•  Opportunity to grow within a scaling freight brokerage and asset-based logistics operation

•  Performance-based advancement



Schedule & Work Setup

•  Full-Time Remote Role | Direct Hire to US Company

•  Available schedules: Thursday - Monday 6 AM - 3 PM Central Time & Wednesday - Sunday 9 AM - 6 PM Central Time

•  Initial Training Schedule (for 2 weeks): Monday - Friday 7 AM - 4 PM Central Time

•  Final shift assignment will be discussed and confirmed during the hiring or training process.

•  Training includes supervised dispute reviews, transportation documentation verification, and familiarization with internal systems.

•  Zoom presence required

•  Time tracking software used for accountability and performance support

•  Reliable computer, primary internet connection, backup internet connection, and home office setup required



This role is built for someone who enjoys investigating transportation issues, analyzing shipment records, and ensuring disputes are supported by accurate documentation. If you are detail driven, organized, proactive, and comfortable handling time-sensitive operational responsibilities, you’ll fit right in.

title: Property Manager & Executive Assistant
description:
I'm a real estate entrepreneur based in Dallas, Texas, running two connected businesses: a real estate sales team that helps buyers and sellers, and a property management company that operates furnished co-living rentals. We use ClickUp for task and project management and Google Drive as our primary file system. We also use Buildium as our main property management tool.

 

I'm looking for a full-time Property Manager who becomes the operational hub for the property management side of the business, overseeing day-to-day execution, tenant and vendor coordination, and making sure our systems and processes are followed accurately and consistently as we continue to scale.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

- Serve as a primary point of contact for tenants, vendors, and taskers (escalating issues as needed)

- Coordinate furnishing installs, turns, maintenance requests, and vendor schedules

- Coordinate closely with the Property Management Department Lead to align priorities and next steps

- Maintain and update SOPs and process documentation as changes are made

- Ensure follow-up and closure on every open item, so nothing falls through the cracks

 

YOU'D BE A GREAT FIT IF

 

- You have property management experience

- You follow instructions exactly and don't cut corners

- You write and speak clearly in English

- You stay calm managing many moving parts

- You take ownership and don't need hand-holding

- You take initiative: you spot issues early, investigate, and propose next steps

- You use good judgment and can prioritize without being told every step

- You are comfortable working on a time clock and logging your hours every day

- Tools experience preferred: Buildium, ClickUp, Google Workspace (we will train; instruction-following matters more than expertise)

 

ROLE DETAILS

 

- Full-time, remote

- Schedule: Fri-Tues, aligned with CST (Wed & Thurs off)

- Pay: $4-6 USD/hour, based on experience

- All work is tracked on a time clock

- Long-term role with growth and bonuses

 

HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

 

Applications that don't follow these instructions are disqualified. Apply by sending a message to me through the OnlineJobs.ph messaging feature on this job post.

 

STEP 1 - MESSAGE

 

1. Send your application as a message through OnlineJobs.ph

2. The first line of your message must be: Property Manager - [Full Name]

3. The message must include only: a short greeting, a Google Drive folder link, and your answer to the Detail Check (Step 3)

 

STEP 2 - GOOGLE DRIVE FOLDER

2. Set sharing to "Anyone with the link can view."

3. Organize it however you think is best. We look at what you submit and how you organize it.

4. Include the following:

- Tech and Setup: a screenshot of your internet speed (download and upload), a screenshot of your computer specs (RAM, processor, OS), and one photo of your workspace (desk and computer)

 

- Written Answers (one Google Doc): (1) Describe one property management role or company you worked with: number of properties or units, your day-to-day responsibilities, and the tools you used. (2) We already have SOPs and systems, but they are still improving. What would you focus on in your first 2 weeks to keep operations running smoothly without constant supervision?

Add a short caption to each: what the system is used for, which tool it is in, and what part you personally designed. If you cannot share a previous client's screenshots, recreate a similar structure in a fresh workspace with fake data.

 

- Video Introduction (2-4 minutes): who you are and where you're based, your property management experience, an example of handling multiple stakeholders at once, and how you personally stay organized

 

STEP 3 - DETAIL CHECK

 

At the very bottom of your message, under the Drive link, write only the price per square foot for this property:

 

3384 P Avenue, Plano, TX 75074 - Sold for 255,555 USD.

 

Include only the final price per square foot number, with no explanation.

 

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

Website:

NeighborlyBuzz is an early-stage resident communication platform for apartment communities and property management teams. The product is built and ready to sell, and we are now focused heavily on growth, relationships, and customer acquisition.

title: Senior Fulfilment and Last Mile Operations Manager
description:
Remote | Full-time



Make the daily decisions that keep deliveries moving, warehouse capacity under control and transport costs balanced.



We are looking for an experienced fulfilment and last mile operations professional to take ownership of the flow of customer orders from our warehouses through to final delivery.



This is a senior, hands-on role with a strong focus on operational judgement. You’ll work closely with the Fulfillment team lead, our warehouse, customer service and transport partners to make practical decisions that balance customer commitments, available space, delivery capacity and cost.



You’ll need to see the whole picture. Sometimes bringing stock forward protects a customer delivery date. Other times, consolidating a linehaul movement makes better commercial sense, or moving stock sooner is necessary to free up warehouse space and keep orders flowing. Your role is to weigh the trade-offs, make the call and ensure the teams involved follow through.



What you’ll be responsible for:



Daily fulfilment decisions: Set priorities across picking, dispatch, stock transfers and delivery, taking account of order readiness, capacity and customer commitments.



Warehouse capacity and stock flow: Work with warehouse leaders to manage space constraints, inbound arrivals and outbound volumes, preventing congestion and unnecessary handling.



Linehaul planning: Balance transfer timing, load utilization and transport costs against stock availability and warehouse capacity.



Last mile delivery: Manage courier and delivery partner performance, bookings, service standards and delivery exceptions.



Customer outcomes: Work with customer service to identify delivery risks early, agree realistic solutions and ensure customers receive clear updates.



Exception management: Resolve competing priorities, delayed movements, failed deliveries and urgent orders, understanding the wider impact of each decision.



Commercial performance: Monitor cost per delivery, linehaul utilisation, redelivery costs and other controllable expenses, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.



Team coordination: Give clear direction, establish ownership and hold internal teams and external partners accountable for agreed actions.



Back office Admin: Leading our back office admin team who liaises with locally based suppliers, will also form part of this positions' remit.



Continuous improvement: Strengthen processes, reporting and systems so the operation becomes more reliable and easier to manage.



You’ll also step into the operation when needed—investigating an issue on the warehouse floor, checking an order or helping the team through a peak period.



What you’ll bring

Strong experience in fulfilment, transport or last mile operations, ideally within furniture, bulky goods, retail or a similar delivery environment.



Experience coordinating warehouses, interstate linehaul movements and external delivery partners.



The ability to make sound decisions when priorities compete and information is incomplete.



Commercial awareness: you understand how delivery promises, stock movements, storage constraints and transport choices affect cost and service.



Confidence using operational data and warehouse, ERP and delivery systems to identify issues and guide decisions.



Clear communication and the ability to work effectively with warehouse teams, customer service, suppliers and senior management.



A practical approach, strong follow-through and a willingness to get involved when needed.



What success looks like



Customer orders move predictably from warehouse to delivery. Stock transfers are planned with both capacity and cost in mind. Delivery risks are identified early, avoidable costs are reduced, and everyone involved understands the priorities and their responsibilities.

title: Loan Coordinator Assistant (Experienced Only) – Hawaii Remote Mortgage Operations
description:
JOB TITLE

Experienced Loan Coordinator Assistant – Remote Mortgage Operations



JOB OVERVIEW

Hawaii Financial Services, LLC (HIFIS) is a small, established mortgage company serving Hawaii home borrowers. We are hiring a dependable Loan Coordinator Assistant to help keep borrower files accurate, organized, current, and moving forward. No NMLS License is required as the Owner and only Loan Officer handles all communications with potential clients regarding loan programs, pricing, etc. which would trigger the NMLS License Requirements.



This is a detail-heavy mortgage operations position. It is not a general virtual-assistant or personal-assistant role. DO NOT APPLY UNLESS YOU HAVE MORTGAGE ASSISTANT/PROCESSING EXPERIENCE. Your application will be deleted.



You will work closely with the company owner. Your responsibilities will include borrower document follow-up, document review and organization, loan-system data entry, written verification ordering & tracking, wash lists creation, status updates, and direct client communications via
, phone calls & texts.



The right person takes ownership of assigned work, checks available information before asking questions, keeps accurate notes, follows through without repeated reminders, and knows when to escalate an issue.



This role does not independently originate, structure, approve, deny, or promise loan terms. Loan-program, qualification, pricing, compliance, and underwriting decisions are all completed by the owner & only licensed originator.



POSITION DETAILS



- Remote position

- Full-time

- Regular overlap with Hawaii Standard Time business hours is required

- Specific days and working hours will be agreed upon before hiring

- Training and responsibility will increase based on demonstrated accuracy, retention, judgment, and independence



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Borrower support and communication

- Help borrowers use the secure online application and document-upload process.

- Follow up by
, phone, and text using approved HIFIS templates and communication standards.

- Search all approved systems and file locations before asking a borrower to resend information.

- Provide prompt acknowledgment and accurate administrative status updates.

- Communicate delays and incomplete assignments before they affect a borrower or loan file.

- Keep the HIFIS Team included in all borrower-related communications as required.

- Refer questions about qualification, loan programs, pricing, approval, compliance, and possible deal-breakers to the owner.



Document review and file organization

- Preserve original borrower documents and never delete or overwrite source files.

- Download and prepare working copies of documents.

- Separate ZIP files, combine or optimize PDFs, and remove document passwords when authorized.

- Rename documents according to detailed HIFIS naming standards.

- Maintain the required borrower folder structure.

- Review documents for missing pages, incomplete date coverage, inconsistencies, duplicates, illegibility, and visible red flags.

- Record concerns clearly and alert the Team instead of making unsupported assumptions.



Loan-system setup and data entry

- Create and name loan files using HIFIS procedures.

- Enter borrower, residence, employment, asset, liability, referral, and other authorized information accurately.

- Cross-check names, addresses, dates, identification, tax documents, paystubs, bank statements, and application information.

- Maintain complete, clear, and professional file notes.

- Identify missing or conflicting information before submitting work for review.



Income, employment, and asset support

- Order written verifications of employment as directed.

- Track verification requests and receipt dates accurately.

- Organize paystubs, W-2s, 1099s, tax returns, K-1s, profit-and-loss statements, and supporting income documents.

- Prepare basic income worksheets according to company procedures, subject to review.

- Review bank and asset statements for ownership, statement periods, account identification, large deposits, earnest-money activity, and other items needing attention.

- Escalate inconsistent income, employment gaps, unexplained deposits, negative self-employment income, and other concerns immediately.



Wash lists, follow-up, and pipeline tracking

- Prepare clear first-round and follow-up lists of missing borrower documents.

- Separate items needed immediately from items that may be provided later.

- Confirm that an item is actually missing before requesting it.

- Track outstanding documents, written verifications, conditions, and assigned follow-up through completion.

- Update InfoDat and other internal systems daily with accurate actions, dates, ownership, and status notes.

- Report completed, pending, blocked, and overdue work before the end of each shift.

- Ask for help early when uncertainty, missing information, or workload could delay a file.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Strong attention to detail

- Must be self sufficient, working independently 

- Accurate data-entry and document-review skills

- Reliable attendance and availability during the agreed schedule

- Ability to manage competing deadlines and follow work through completion

- Ability to follow detailed written procedures and naming standards

- Willingness to use checklists, reference materials, and quality-control steps

- Good judgment about when to proceed and when to ask for help

- Ability to accept detailed feedback and retain corrections

- High integrity and discretion when handling confidential personal and financial information

- Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PDF tools, and cloud-based document systems

- A quiet, dependable remote workspace with reliable internet service

- Prior experience in a deadline-driven administrative or operations position



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Experience in one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred:

- U.S. residential mortgage processing or loan coordination

- Loan officer assistance/ processing

- Real estate transaction coordination

- High-volume client follow-up

- Calyx Point

- ShareFile

- Mortgage documentation and lending terminology

- Income-document review

- Creating or following standard operating procedures



A college degree is helpful but is not required when the applicant can demonstrate equivalent skills and experience. SAFE Mortgage Loan Originator pre-licensing education is helpful but does not replace HIFIS training or authorization.



HOW PERFORMANCE WILL BE EVALUATED

Performance will be based on:

- Accuracy of data, documents, names, dates, and file notes

- Timely communication and status reporting

- Proper preservation, naming, and organization of documents

- Follow-through on outstanding items

- Daily visibility into completed, pending, and blocked work

- Compliance with the boundaries of the position

- Retention of corrections

- Increasing independence within assigned responsibilities



Training will begin with HIFIS procedures, document-control standards, systems, communication requirements, and supervised file work. Access and responsibilities will increase only after the employee demonstrates consistent accuracy, confidentiality, follow-through, and sound judgment.



HOW TO APPLY

Please use the subject line:

HIFIS LCA APPLICATION – [YOUR FULL NAME]



Your application must include:

1. A brief introduction describing your relevant experience.

2. The number of years you have worked in mortgage, lending, real estate, banking, accounting, or another deadline-driven operations position.

3. The mortgage and document-management systems you have used.

4. Your available working hours in Hawaii Standard Time.

5. Your expected hourly or monthly compensation in U.S. dollars.

6. A description of a time you found and corrected an inconsistency in a document, record, or customer file.

7. The answer to this question: What would you do if a borrower asked whether they qualify for a specific loan program?



Please attach your résumé and include the word “PINEAPPLE” at the end of your application. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered as it shows you have not read the entirety of this post.

title: CRM Migration Specialist (GoHighLevel/NetScore to Zoom)
description:
We are looking for an experienced contractor to help migrate our existing CRM data and communication workflows from GoHighLevel (GHL)/NetScore to Zoom and Google Workspace (Calendar and Sheets). All existing data has been exported to CSV files.



We need someone to build a system in which Google Sheets serves as the central database for our contacts and tags, with two-way synchronization, where feasible, between Google Sheets, Google Calendar, and Zoom. The system should also support Google Forms for client/patient forms and signatures.



Additionally, we would like to use ZoomMate as a workaround for Zoom’s workflow/drip campaign and tagging limitations. We understand this may require additional development and configuration, but we believe it is feasible and are looking for someone who can assess and implement this solution.



The project will involve:

    • Migrating existing contacts, tags, and relevant data from CSV files to Google Calendar/Sheets to integrate to Zoom.

    • Getting Google sheets to host the contacts and tags, and be integrated with Zoom for drip campaigns

    • Rebuilding existing workflows (reminders, followups, after a specific trigger) in ZoomMate that work with Google calendar and Google sheets

    • Integrating Zoom with Google Sheets and Google Calendar, with two-way data synchronization.

    • Connecting the workflow to Google Forms for client/patient forms and signatures. Configure workflows so new contacts go to Google sheets

    • Testing the migration and workflows to ensure everything functions correctly.

    • Providing an RFP (request for proposal) or project documentation outlining the proposed solution, scope, and implementation plan.



Our current use of NetScore/GHL mainly involves calendar management and scheduling, one-to-one messaging, drip campaigns and bulk messaging, and automated workflows for reminders, contact tagging, and SMS/email communications triggered by customer behavior.



This is a remote project. Please provide a fixed-fee quote, estimated timeline, and proposed approach. Please also indicate your experience with CRM migrations, Zoom integrations, Google Workspace, and workflow automation.



This is a one-time migration and implementation project, but it may require 3–6 months of follow-up technical support, monitoring, troubleshooting, and adjustments to ensure the system runs reliably after launch. Please specify whether ongoing support is included in your quote or priced separately.

title: Intake Coordinator
description:
Maintenance Intake Coordinator

Philippines-based · Full-time · Independent contractor · Long-term

Engagement

Independent contractor (you invoice us; you handle your own taxes)

Location

Remote, Philippines-based

Hours

U.S. Pacific coverage — 8Am - 5Pm

Pay

US$6/ hour, paid in USD via Wise · plus a health allowance

Reports to

The Maintenance Dispatch Lead

Tools provided

AppFolio, Vonage (maintenance hotline), the shared work-order tracker,
 and chat

About Us

We manage a large residential portfolio in Los Angeles — roughly 170 properties, served by an in-house crew and a roster of outside vendors. Every repair starts with a request from a resident, an owner, or a property. This role is where those requests land.

The Role

You are the front door. Every maintenance request — phone,
, or portal — comes to you first. You capture it completely, classify it correctly, and route it to the right person, all on first contact. When a request can be resolved in one exchange, you resolve it and close it. When it cannot, you make sure it reaches the right hands with nothing missing. A request that is logged incompletely or routed to the wrong place costs the whole team hours downstream — getting it right at intake is the job.

What You'll Do

● Take every request. Answer the maintenance hotline and monitor the maintenance inbox during your shift. Be the calm, professional first voice a resident hears.

● Capture it completely. Get the full picture on first contact — property and unit, resident and best contact number, what is wrong, when it started, access instructions and pets, and whether anyone is without heat, water, or power. Incomplete intake is the most expensive mistake in this role.

● Classify it correctly. Assign the right category (Electrical, Plumbing, Carpentry, Painting, HVAC, Masonry & Tiling, General Maintenance) and the right urgency — emergency, same-day, or routine — using our written criteria.

● Resolve what you can on the spot. Many requests are answered in a single exchange — a question, a scheduling confirmation, a simple troubleshooting step. Handle those fully and close them rather than passing them along.

● Route the rest, cleanly. Send in-house work and vendor work to the correct coordinator with everything they need to act. Never leave a request unassigned.

● Log everything in AppFolio. AppFolio is our system of record. Every request is entered accurately and promptly, with its category, urgency, and assigned party.

● Escalate emergencies immediately. Gas smell, flooding, no heat, electrical hazard, or anything affecting safety goes out the moment you hear it — you never queue a life-safety issue.

● Keep residents informed. Confirm receipt, set realistic expectations, and answer follow-up questions courteously.

What We're Looking For

Two things matter most: that you are organized enough that nothing slips between the call and the log, and that you are genuinely good with people on the phone.

● Strong organizational skills. You work from a system, not memory. You capture details as you go, you finish what you start, and a request never sits half-logged while you move to the next one.

● A customer support background. Experience in a call center, help desk, service desk, or similar — you have handled real volume, worked a queue, and dealt with frustrated people professionally.

● Clear spoken English. You will be on the phone with U.S. residents all shift. This is load-bearing, not optional.

● Clear written English. Your notes are what the rest of the team works from — they must be complete and easy to follow.

● Calm under pressure. A resident with water coming through the ceiling at 2 a.m. needs someone steady. You ask the right questions and act fast without getting flustered.

● Judgment about urgency. You can tell the difference between a dripping faucet and a burst pipe, and you know which one cannot wait.

● Accuracy with details. Unit numbers, phone numbers, and access notes have to be right the first time.

● A plus: property management, facilities, dispatch, or home-warranty experience; AppFolio; prior work on U.S. hours.

The Boundaries of This Role

For clarity, this role does NOT include:

● D
 who does the work, setting scope, or directing the field crew — that belongs to the Maintenance Dispatch Lead.

● Any approval authority over money, banking access, or signature authority.

● Legal or rent-control work product, or owner-relationship decisions.

What Success Looks Like

● Every request is logged completely and accurately on first contact — nobody downstream has to call the resident back for basic information.

● Requests are classified and routed correctly, so work starts without a detour.

● Simple requests are closed at intake rather than added to someone else's queue.

● Emergencies move immediately, every time.

How to Apply — Read Carefully

To be considered, your application MUST include all of the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed.

#

Include with your application

1

Internet speed proof. A Speedtest.net screenshot showing at least 25 Mbps download.

2

A 30-second voice recording. Using your phone’s voice recorder, record yourself answering: “Describe the system you use so nothing you’re responsible for gets forgotten.” Save the audio to Google Drive, set it to “anyone with the link can view,” and include the link. Speak naturally — we are not looking for polish, just clear spoken English, since this role is on the phone all shift.

3

A short judgment answer. A resident calls at 9 p.m. and says water is dripping from the ceiling light fixture in her bedroom. What exactly do you ask her, what do you do, and how urgent is it?

4

A short intake sample. Write the note you would leave in the system after that call — exactly as the next person would read it.

5

Two short answers (a few sentences each): (a) Describe your customer support experience — what kind of queue or volume did you handle? (b) Your current internet provider and your backup plan for outages.

6

Your rate in USD, your earliest availability, and the U.S. Pacific hours you can commit to.

Why these? They mirror the actual work. Strong applications move to a short skills exercise, a video interview, and reference checks.

Our Process

● Application review against the requirements above.

● Skills exercise (a realistic intake and classification exercise).

● Video interview, including a short live phone role-play.

● Reference checks, then offer.

title: Vehicle Wrap Designer
description:
# Job Title: Sign & Vehicle Wrap Designer



**Department:** Creative & Production



**Reports To:** Production Manager / Creative Director



**Job Type:** Full-Time



---



## Role Overview



We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly creative, and technical **Sign & Vehicle Wrap Designer** to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for creating high-impact visual designs for full/partial vehicle wraps, commercial fleets, exterior/interior architectural signage, and large-format environmental graphics.



Unlike standard graphic design roles, this position requires a deep understanding of spatial geometry, 3D surface contours, scale, color management, and large-format print prepress. You will work directly with clients to translate their branding into real-world applications and collaborate with our print operators and installation technicians to ensure seamless execution.



---



## Key Responsibilities



### Design & Concept Creation



* Design custom, high-resolution graphics for partial and full vehicle wraps, fleet vehicles, window vinyl, wall murals, dimensional signage, and banners.

* Utilize specialized vehicle templates (e.g., Pro Vehicle Outlines, Badie) to precisely position graphics across complex 3D vehicle body contours, body seams, door handles, and windows.

* Build realistic 2D and 3D photo mockups for client approvals to accurately represent the final installed product.

* Interpret client branding guidelines, logos, and briefs to create eye-catching visual concepts that align with the client’s marketing goals.



### Prepress & Production File Preparation



* Convert approved concepts into precision, print-ready vector/raster files scaled at full size (1:1) or accurate architectural scale (e.g., 1:10).

* Set up print files with appropriate bleeds, overlapping panels, tiling, overlap seam allowances, and vector contour cut lines (CutContour).

* Ensure correct color profiling (CMYK, Pantone/PMS matching) and image resolution settings to prevent pixelation on large-format outputs.

* Nest cut graphics and print files efficiently to minimize material waste during printing and cutting.





Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly creative, and technical Sign & Vehicle Wrap Designer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for creating high-impact visual designs for full/partial vehicle wraps, commercial fleets, exterior/interior architectural signage, and large-format environmental graphics.



Unlike standard graphic design roles, this position requires a deep understanding of spatial geometry, 3D surface contours, scale, color management, and large-format print prepress. You will work directly with clients to translate their branding into real-world applications and collaborate with our print operators and installation technicians to ensure seamless execution.



---



## Qualifications & Skills



### Required



* **Experience:** 2–5+ years of proven graphic design experience specifically in the sign, large-format print, or vehicle wrap industry.

* **Software Proficiency:** Advanced mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud (specifically **Adobe Illustrator** and **Adobe Photoshop**).

* **Technical Knowledge:** Strong understanding of vector graphics, raster resolution requirements (DPI vs. dimensions), scale calculations, and color theory (CMYK vs. RGB vs. Spot Colors).

* **Spatial Awareness:** Demonstrated ability to visualize flat 2D designs applied to complex 3D surfaces (curves, rivets, recessed panels).

* **Attention to Detail:** Meticulous approach to measurements, spell-checking, bleed allowances, and file organization.

* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal communication skills for presenting concepts to clients and technical handoffs to installers.

title: Amazon PPC & SEO Specialist
description:
Zoniverse is a full-service Amazon agency. We’re hiring a full-time employee with hands-on experience in Amazon PPC, SEO and listing optimization to work across our client accounts.



You’ll use advertising and organic search performance to identify opportunities, make improvements and track results. This includes campaign changes, keyword targeting and recommendations for titles, bullets, main images, image stacks and A+ Content.



We provide training on our workflows and copywriting standards. Your practical experience with PPC, SEO and listing optimization is what matters most.



Responsibilities



Amazon PPC



* Manage & launch campaigns with clear goals, purposes, and strategy.

* Analyze search terms, keywords, product targets and placements.

* Adjust bids and budgets, harvest search terms and add negatives.

* Monitor advertising efficiency alongside total account performance.

* Identify when weak results require a targeting, listing or offer change.



Amazon SEO



* Research and prioritize relevant keywords using search, advertising and competitor data.

* Monitor organic rankings and indexation regularly.

* Identify ranking gaps and update listing keywords where appropriate.

* Track whether changes improve visibility and performance.



Listing Optimization



* Use PPC and SEO findings to improve listing relevance, click-through rate and conversion.

* Recommend changes to main images, image stacks, titles, bullets, backend terms and A+ Content.

* Give designers clear briefs explaining the benefit, customer question or objection each image should address.

* Write and refine listing copy, using AI where helpful.

* Record performance baselines, document changes and follow up to evaluate results.



Reporting and Organization



* Maintain account-specific priorities and change logs across multiple brands and ASINs.

* Report what changed, why it changed, what happened and what needs attention next.

* Communicate blockers and complete recurring work on schedule.



Requirements



* At least two years of hands-on Amazon experience, with practical experience in **all three areas: PPC, SEO and listing optimization**. This does not mean two separate years in each.

* Experience personally managing PPC campaigns, conducting keyword research, monitoring organic rankings and improving listings.

* Ability to explain a real performance problem you identified and the actions you took.

* Working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Ads Console and keyword research tools such as Helium 10 or Data Dive.

* Comfortable analyzing reports in Excel or Google Sheets.

* Ability to keep work organized across multiple accounts and ASINs.

* Clear English communication and reliable follow-through.



Experience with Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance, listing experiments and designer collaboration is a plus.



How to Apply



Begin your application with **SEARCH FLYWHEEL**, attach your resume and answer these questions:



1. How many years of hands-on experience do you have in Amazon PPC, SEO and listing optimization?

2. How many Amazon brands or accounts have you personally managed simultaneously?

3. Describe one specific Amazon PPC problem you personally diagnosed. What did you find, what did you change and what were the results?

4. Share one example of PPC or SEO data leading to a listing recommendation. What did the data show, what did you recommend and how did you evaluate the result?



Keep your answers concise and based on work you personally performed. Client names can remain confidential.

Can you take a problem you've never seen before and figure out how to solve it? That's the person we're looking for.





We own and manage long-term residential and short term vacation rentals. We care more about how you think than about your exact job history. We are not looking for a simple task-doer; we want someone who can be given a problem, think through the steps needed to solve it, and come back with the resources and solutions to do so. If you'd prefer flexible, unstructured hours, this isn't the job.

Positive Energy: Property management sometimes involves surprise challenges. Pipes burst, tenants stop paying. It is critical that we approach our work with a positive attitude. We value collaboration, open communication, and a "can-do" spirit.





A Relationship, Not a Transaction: We want a years-long partnership where you feel supported, trusted, and empowered to make decisions as you grow. Your pay and responsibilities are reviewed at 3 and 6 months.
